normal.explain: 英文原句：The fallen trees have blocked the main road. 意思：倒塌的樹木已經堵住了主要道路。（have blocked 已經堵住）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The new semester has just started.
options: A. 新的學期剛剛開始。
B. 新學期的課程已經結束了。
C. 上個學期的成績已經公布。
D. 學生們正在準備新學期的考試。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The new semester has just started. 意思：新的學期剛剛開始。（has started 已經開始）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you skip the first class, you will lose points.
options: A. 如果你第一堂課遲到，老師會生氣。
B. 如果你跳過第一堂課，你就會被扣分。
C. 如果你沒帶課本，上課就無法得分。
D. 如果你第一堂課表現好，就會獲得加分。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you skip the first class, you will lose points. 意思：如果你跳過（翹掉）第一堂課，你就會被扣分。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the reading list been given by the professor?
options: A. Yes, he read a famous book last night.
B. No, the list of students is not ready yet.
C. Yes, he uploaded it to the school website yesterday.
D. No, I cannot read his handwriting.
normal.explain: 英文原句：Has the reading list been given by the professor? 意思：教授已經給出閱讀書單了嗎？選項 C「有，他昨天已經把它上傳到學校網站了」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The campus map has been mailed to every freshman.
options: A. 校園地圖已經郵寄給每位新生。
B. 每位新生都必須去辦公室領取校園地圖。
C. 學校官網上已經更新了最新的校園地圖。
D. 新生們正在校園裡尋找地圖上的建築物。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The campus map has been mailed to every freshman. 意思：校園地圖已經郵寄給每位新生。（has been mailed 已經被郵寄）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you want a locker, you will need to pay first.
options: A. 如果你的置物櫃壞了，需要付費修理。
B. 如果你想要一個置物櫃，你需要先付費。
C. 如果你想換置物櫃，必須先填寫申請表。
D. 如果你不需要置物櫃，可以申請退費。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you want a locker, you will need to pay first. 意思：如果你想要一個置物櫃，你需要先付費。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have all the assignments been submitted online?
options: A. Yes, the internet connection is very fast here.
B. No, the assignment is about international business.
C. Yes, the teacher has received everyone's work.
D. No, we have bought the materials online.
normal.explain: 英文原句：Have all the assignments been submitted online? 意思：所有的作業都已經在網路上繳交了嗎？選項 C「是的，老師已經收到每個人的作品了」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The textbook has been chosen for this course.
options: A. 這門課的教科書已經選定了。
B. 這門課不需要購買任何教科書。
C. 教授正在為這門課挑選教科書。
D. 學生們正在圖書館借閱這門課的教科書。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The textbook has been chosen for this course. 意思：這門課的教科書已經選定了。（has been chosen 已經被選擇）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The annual dinner has been held in a luxury hotel.
options: A. 今年的年度晚宴因為經費不足被取消了。
B. 員工們正在期待即將在飯店舉辦的晚宴。
C. 年度晚宴已經在一間豪華飯店舉行過了。
D. 豪華飯店拒絕了公司舉辦晚宴的申請。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The annual dinner has been held in a luxury hotel. 意思：年度晚宴已經在一間豪華飯店舉行過了。（has been held 已經被舉辦）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If it pours outside, we will take a taxi.
options: A. 如果外面出大太陽，我們就撐傘。
B. 如果外面塞車，我們就搭捷運。
C. 如果外面下雪，我們就走路回家。
D. 如果外面下傾盆大雨，我們就搭計程車。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If it pours outside, we will take a taxi. 意思：如果外面下傾盆大雨，我們就搭計程車。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have the dinner tables been set up properly?
options: A. Yes, all the plates and glasses are in the right place.
B. No, the dinner was quite expensive for our team.
C. Yes, I sit at the front table near the stage.
D. No, the proper way to speak is standing up.
normal.explain: 英文原句：Have the dinner tables been set up properly? 意思：餐桌都已經妥當佈置好了嗎？選項 A「是的，所有的盤子和玻璃杯都在正確的位置」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The opening speech has been given by the president.
options: A. 總裁即將在台上發表開幕演說。
B. 開幕演說因為總裁遲到而延後。
C. 總裁已經發表了開幕演說。
D. 總裁拒絕發表今年的開幕演說。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The opening speech has been given by the president. 意思：總裁已經發表了開幕演說。（has been given 已經被給予/發表）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you wear casual clothes, you will not be allowed inside.
options: A. 如果你穿休閒服，可以獲得免費飲料。
B. 如果你不穿制服，就必須待在後排。
C. 如果你穿得很正式，就會受到熱烈歡迎。
D. 如果你穿休閒服，你將不被允許進入。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you wear casual clothes, you will not be allowed inside. 意思：如果你穿休閒服，你將不被允許進入。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has the final menu been created by the chef?
options: A. Yes, he has prepared five amazing courses for us.
B. No, the chef is a very famous person in this city.
C. Yes, the menu is printed in French and English.
D. No, I usually cook my own dinner at home.
normal.explain: 英文原句：Has the final menu been created by the chef? 意思：最終的菜單已經由主廚設計出來了嗎？選項 A「是的，他已經為我們準備了五道驚豔的菜色」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The lucky prize has been bought for tonight.
options: A. 今晚的幸運大獎是由總經理提供的。
B. 今晚的幸運大獎已經被某個員工抽走了。
C. 今晚的幸運大獎已經買好了。
D. 今晚的幸運大獎還沒有決定要買什麼。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The lucky prize has been bought for tonight. 意思：今晚的幸運大獎已經買好了。（has been bought 已經被購買）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The membership fee has been collected this month.
options: A. 這個月的會員費已經收了。
B. 會員費從下個月開始調漲。
C. 健身房已經暫停收取會員費。
D. 會員費必須在每個月底前繳交。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The membership fee has been collected this month. 意思：這個月的會員費已經收了。（has been collected 已經被收取）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you sign the paper, the first month will be free.
options: A. 如果你填寫問卷，就能獲得一張免費體驗券。
B. 如果你在文件上簽名，第一個月將會是免費的。
C. 如果你帶朋友來報名，你就能免費運動一個月。
D. 如果你取消合約，第一個月的費用將不予退還。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you sign the paper, the first month will be free. 意思：如果你在文件上簽名，第一個月將會是免費的。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Has your personal trainer been assigned yet?
options: A. Yes, I always train by myself after work.
B. No, the train leaves the station at five.
C. Yes, a senior coach will help me from tomorrow.
D. No, my personal belongings are in the locker.
normal.explain: 英文原句：Has your personal trainer been assigned yet? 意思：你的私人教練已經指派了嗎？選項 C「是的，一位資深教練明天開始會協助我」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: The clean towels have been washed by the staff.
options: A. 乾淨的毛巾已經由工作人員洗好了。
B. 工作人員正在幫會員發放乾淨的毛巾。
C. 健身房要求會員自己攜帶乾淨的毛巾。
D. 工作人員忘記把髒毛巾拿去清洗了。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The clean towels have been washed by the staff. 意思：乾淨的毛巾已經由工作人員洗好了。（have been washed 已經被清洗）

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you lift heavy weights, your muscles will grow.
options: A. 如果你每天跑步，心肺功能會變好。
B. 如果你舉重物，你的肌肉就會生長。
C. 如果你拉伸身體，肌肉就不會受傷。
D. 如果你吃太多，體重就會快速增加。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If you lift heavy weights, your muscles will grow. 意思：如果你舉重物，你的肌肉就會生長。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Have you stretched your legs before the run?
options: A. Yes, running is my favorite sport in the morning.
B. No, my legs are very long and strong.
C. Yes, I did a ten-minute warmup just now.
D. No, I usually stretch my arms after swimming.
normal.explain: 英文原句：Have you stretched your legs before the run? 意思：你在跑步前有伸展雙腿了嗎？選項 C「有，我剛剛做了十分鐘的暖身」最合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: A new workout routine has been designed for you.
options: A. 已經為你設計了一套新的健身常規訓練。
B. 你必須按照這套新的健身計畫嚴格執行。
C. 健身房推出了一套適合所有人的新常規課程。
D. 你的健身教練要求你自行設計一套訓練常規。
normal.explain: 英文原句：A new workout routine has been designed for you. 意思：已經為你設計了一套新的健身常規訓練。（has been designed 已經被設計）

normal.desc: 【時態】Since he joined the team, he ___ three different marketing tasks.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句首有 Since 加上過去式，主要子句需用現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示從過去持續到現在的動作或經驗。因此選 has managed。其他選項時態不符。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ my password, so I cannot log into the system right now.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：忘記密碼是發生在過去但對「現在」造成影響（無法登入）的動作，應使用現在完成式。A 是現在簡單式，C 是動名詞/現在分詞，D 是被動語態（我被忘記），皆不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the train ___ late, we will take a taxi to the airport instead.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 條件句表示對未來可能發生的情況做假設時，If 子句應使用「現在簡單式」代替未來式，因此選 is。A 錯誤因為 If 條件句中不加 will。

normal.desc: 【條件句】You will miss your flight if you ___ at the gate on time.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：這是一般條件句（第一類條件句），主要子句用未來式 (will miss)，If 子句要用現在簡單式。否定寫法為 do not arrive。A 缺乏助動詞，B 是過去式，C 是現在進行式。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The daily schedule ___ by the manager every morning before work begins.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 The daily schedule 是動作承受者（被更新），且由 every morning 可知是常態性動作，需用現在簡單式的被動語態 (is/are + p.p.)，故選 is updated。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】These smart devices ___ in Taiwan for the global market.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 devices（裝置）無法自己製造，必須「被製造」，因此要用被動語態 (are + produced)。A, C, D 均為主動語態，不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【字彙】You need a valid passport to confirm your ___ at the airport desk.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句意為「你需要有效的護照來確認你的身分」。identity 意為身分；package 是包裹，weather 是天氣，mistake 是錯誤，皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【時態】They ___ the new software on all office computers yet.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句尾有 yet，通常搭配現在完成式的否定句或疑問句，表示「到目前為止尚未...」。因此正確答案為 have not installed。

normal.desc: 【時態】She ___ as a freelance writer since she graduated from university.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：since + 過去時間點/子句，主要子句需搭配現在完成式，表示從過去某個時間點一直持續到現在的狀態。故選 has worked。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you ___ this button, the machine will stop automatically.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：第一類條件句中，主要子句用 will stop，If 子句用現在簡單式表示可能發生的條件。因此選 press。C 錯誤因為 If 子句不用 will。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the customer ___ not like the color, she can return the shirt for a refund.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在簡單式，主詞 the customer 是第三人稱單數，否定助動詞需用 does。A 的 do 用法錯誤，B 和 D 語法不合。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The final exam papers ___ by the teachers next week.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 exam papers 是被批改的對象，且時間是 next week（下週），所以需要未來式的被動語態 (will be + p.p.)，故選 will be marked。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】A confirmation email ___ to your inbox immediately after you pay.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：email 無法自己發送，必須「被發送」，所以需用被動語態 (is + sent)。這是一個陳述系統常態運作的句子，用現在簡單被動式最適合。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The health expert ___ eating more vegetables to lower your blood pressure.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：健康專家「建議」多吃蔬菜以降低血壓。suggests 意為建議；forgets (忘記)、designs (設計)、paints (畫) 都不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ a lot of positive feedback from our guests this month.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：this month 指「這個月到目前為止」，常搭配現在完成式 (have/has + p.p.) 來表達目前為止的經驗或累積的結果。因此選 have received。

normal.desc: 【時態】He ___ all his tasks for today, so he can go home early.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：動作剛完成並對現在造成影響（可以提早回家），最適合用現在完成式 (has finished)。B 過去式缺乏明確過去時間點，且不如完成式能強調與現在的關聯。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If we buy the tickets online, they ___ much cheaper than at the station.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在式 (buy)，主要子句表示未來的結果，應使用未來式 (will + 原形動詞)。因此選 will be。

normal.desc: 【條件句】The doctor will see you now if you ___ an appointment.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：條件句的主要子句為 will see，因此 if 子句需用現在簡單式表示條件。you 搭配動詞 have。C 錯在 if 子句不用 will。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】This beautiful wooden chair ___ by a local artist in the 1990s.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：椅子是「被製作」的，且時間是過去的 1990 年代，故應使用過去簡單式的被動語態 (was/were + p.p.)。正確答案為 was made。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】Some extra chairs ___ to the meeting room before the guests arrive.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 chairs 是動作承受者，且由 before the guests arrive（在客人抵達前）可知動作發生在未來，需用未來被動語態 (will be + p.p.)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you sent the files? 
B: Not yet. If I finish editing them, I ___ them to you right away.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：B 回答中的 If 子句用現在式 (finish)，表示未來的假設條件，主要子句應搭配未來式 (will + 原形動詞)，表示「我將會寄給你」。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Where is my package? 
B: It ___ by the delivery company yesterday afternoon.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：包裹是被運送的（被動語態），且時間是 yesterday afternoon（過去時間），所以要用過去簡單被動語態 (was delivered)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the report ready? 
B: Yes, I ___ it, and it is on your desk now.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：B 表示已經印好了且報告在桌上，強調過去動作對現在造成的結果，使用現在完成式 (have printed) 最合適。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the road closed? 
B: It ___ by the heavy rain last night.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：道路是「被淹沒」的，時間是 last night，所以必須用過去簡單式的被動語態 (was flooded)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Can I still join the tour? 
B: Yes, if you pay the fee now, I ___ your name to the list.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：這是一般條件句，If 子句用現在式 (pay)，表示只要現在付費，主要子句就會發生，所以主要子句用未來式 (will add)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The hotel charges an extra ___ if you want to check out after 2:00 PM.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：飯店會收取額外的「費用 (fee)」。menu(菜單)、flight(航班)、weather(天氣)皆不符合上下文。

normal.desc: 【字彙】If you have any unusual ___, you should see a doctor immediately.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：句意為「如果有任何不尋常的症狀，你應該立刻看醫生」。symptoms 意思是症狀，符合醫療情境。

normal.desc: 【綜合句型】The manager ___ the meeting because several key members were sick.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：雖然 because 子句是過去式，但主要子句描述的「取消」這件事是已經發生且影響到現在的狀態，因此使用現在完成式 (has canceled) 是合理的。也可解釋為剛做的決定。

normal.desc: 【綜合句型】If the weather ___ bad tomorrow, the outdoor concert will be moved indoors.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：條件句中，表示未來的假設情況時，If 子句必須用現在簡單式代替未來式，因此選 is。

normal.desc: 【綜合句型】All the dirty dishes must ___ before we close the kitchen tonight.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：盤子必須「被洗」，助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞，因此被動語態的結構為 must + be + p.p.，故選 be washed。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you ever visited Tokyo? 
B: Yes, I ___ there twice for business trips.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：回答「曾經去過幾次」是表達從過去到現在累積的經驗，應使用現在完成式 (have traveled)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Will the shop be open on Sunday? 
B: No, it ___ on weekends.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：表達商店在週末「是不營業的/關閉的」狀態，習慣上用 be closed (這裡視為被動語態或形容詞皆可)，表示一種常態，故選 is closed。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What happens if I lose my room key? 
B: If you lose it, you ___ a fine of fifty dollars.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在式 (lose)，表示未來可能發生的狀況，主要子句則用未來式表示結果 (will pay)。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Are the documents ready for signing? 
B: Yes, they ___ by the legal team already.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文件是「被檢查」，且句尾有 already，表示動作已經完成，要用現在完成式的被動語態 (have been + p.p.)。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Please keep your ___ with you at all times when you are at the airport.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在機場隨時要帶在身邊的是「行李 (luggage)」。custom 是習俗，identity 是身分，symptom 是症狀。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The museum has a wonderful ___ of ancient Roman coins on the second floor.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：博物館在二樓有很棒的古羅馬硬幣「收藏 (collection)」。

normal.desc: 【綜合句型】If you want to access the fast internet, a password ___ by the staff.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：密碼是「被提供」的對象，所以需要被動語態 (must be provided)。B, C, D 都是主動語態。

normal.desc: 【時態】We ___ working together on this new marketing strategy since January.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：有 since + 過去時間點，應搭配現在完成進行式或完成式。這裡填入 have been 形成 have been working，表示從一月一直合作到現在。

normal.desc:
【短文】Notice: The public pool will be closed for cleaning from Monday to Wednesday. If you wish to swim, visit the sports center nearby. Your membership card will be accepted there. 
Question: What should members do if they want to swim on Tuesday?
options: C. Go to the sports center
D. Buy a new membership card
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文提到週一到週三游泳池關閉，如果想游泳可以去附近的運動中心 (visit the sports center nearby)。因此週二想游泳應該選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文】Health News: Drinking coffee late in the day can ruin your sleep. Experts say that if you avoid caffeine after 2 PM, your sleep quality will improve. 
Question: What is the main advice given in the text?
options: A. Sleep more in the afternoon
D. Avoid coffee in the late afternoon
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文建議下午兩點後避免攝取咖啡因 (avoid caffeine after 2 PM) 以改善睡眠品質，因此最符合的建議是 D (避免在傍晚喝咖啡)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Workplace Rule: All workers must wear their ID cards inside the building. If you forget your card, a temporary one will be given at the front desk. 
Question: What happens if a worker forgets their ID card?
options: A. They can get a temporary one
B. They must go back home
C. They have to pay a fine
D. They are not allowed to enter
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中清楚說明，如果忘記帶卡，櫃台會發給一張臨時卡 (a temporary one will be given at the front desk)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Travel Tips: When traveling in Europe, carry some cash. Small local markets only take cash. If you buy fresh fruit from a street seller, you will need coins. 
Question: Why is it important to carry cash?
options: A. Because credit cards are illegal
B. To buy things from small markets
C. Because banks are always closed
D. To pay for expensive hotels
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到當地小市場只收現金 (Small local markets only take cash)，因此帶現金是為了在這些地方購物。

normal.desc:
【短文】Product Manual: Thank you for buying the Smart Blender. The blades are sharp and must be washed by hand. If you put them in the dishwasher, they will become dull. 
Question: How should the user clean the blades?
options: C. By washing them by hand
D. By leaving them in water
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：說明書中指出刀片必須用手洗 (must be washed by hand)，放進洗碗機 (dishwasher) 會變鈍。故選 C。

normal.desc:
【短文】Community Event: We are hosting a bake sale this Saturday for the local library. Many cakes have been baked by our helpers. If it rains, the event will be moved to the school hall. 
Question: Where will the event be if the weather is bad?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句說：如果下雨，活動將移至學校大廳 (moved to the school hall)。壞天氣指的就是下雨，因此選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文】Health Tips: Stretching before running is no longer suggested by some experts. They believe a light jog is better. If you start with a slow run, your body will warm up naturally. 
Question: What is a good warm-up activity?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到專家認為輕鬆慢跑 (a light jog) 是更好的暖身方式，不再建議跑前拉筋。故選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】Travel Info: The night train to Vienna departs at 10 PM. Travelers must board at least twenty minutes early. Once closed, the doors will not open again. 
Question: When is the latest time to board the train?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：火車晚上十點出發 (10 PM)，旅客必須至少提早二十分鐘上車，因此最晚的上車時間是晚上 9:40。故選 B。

normal.desc:
【短文】Company Email: Our winter party is on December 15th. We will serve many foods, including vegetarian dishes. If you have other dietary needs, reply to this email by Friday. 
Question: What should a person do if they cannot eat certain foods?
options: C. Reply to the email by Friday
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：信中指出如果有其他的飲食需求 (dietary needs)，請在週五前回覆此電子郵件 (reply to this email by Friday)。

normal.desc:
【短文】Shopping Guide: Our store offers a price-match promise. If you find the same item for a lower price elsewhere, we will match it. Just show us the ad within seven days. 
Question: How can a customer get a lower price?
options: A. By returning the item quickly
B. By writing a positive review
C. By buying two items at once
D. By showing a cheaper ad from elsewhere
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：商店承諾，只要出示別處較低價格的廣告 (show us the ad)，就可以獲得一樣的低價。因此選 D。

normal.desc:
【短文】City News: A new glass recycling system has been launched downtown. Special bins have been placed everywhere. If this system is successful, it will be expanded next year. 
Question: What will happen if the system is successful?
options: A. It will be expanded next year
B. The bins will be removed
C. The city will cancel the program
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文最後一句明確表示：如果系統成功，明年將會擴大實施 (it will be expanded next year)。故選 A。

normal.desc:
【短文】Tech Update: The latest software update includes security fixes. It is highly recommended to install it. If you ignore it, your personal files might be at risk. 
Question: Why should users install the update?
options: A. To make their computer faster
B. To protect their personal files
C. To download a new game
D. To get a free software license
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到如果不更新，個人檔案可能會有風險 (your personal files might be at risk)，因此更新的目的是為了保護個人檔案。故選 B。

normal.desc: 【時態】The landlord ___ the broken window in the living room.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。主詞 landlord（房東）是第三人稱單數，用 has 加上過去分詞 fixed，表示已經完成的動作。其他選項的時態或主謂一致不正確。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you ___ the rent late, you will pay an extra fee.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句（First Conditional）。If 引導的條件子句需使用現在簡單式來代替未來式，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 pay。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The keys ___ to the new renters yesterday afternoon.
normal.explain: 這題測試過去式的被動語態。時間副詞為 yesterday afternoon（昨天下午），主詞 keys（鑰匙）是接受動作的事物，需搭配 were 加上過去分詞 given。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Please pack all your books into this wooden ___.
normal.explain: 這題測試字彙。carton 意為「紙箱、紙盒」，符合打包書本的情境。screen（螢幕）、medal（獎牌）、module（模組）皆不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】I ___ all the online videos for this week's lesson.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。表示到目前為止已經完成的動作，主詞 I 搭配 have 加上過去分詞 watched。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the internet connection ___, you will lose your quiz answers.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 子句中需用現在簡單式，主詞 connection 是單數，因此動詞需加 s 變成 fails。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The final grades ___ by the system automatically next Monday.
normal.explain: 這題測試未來式的被動語態。時間是 next Monday（下週一），主詞 grades 是被系統計算的，因此選 will be calculated。

normal.desc: 【字彙】You must complete every ___ before moving to the next level.
normal.explain: 這題測試字彙。assignment 指「作業、任務」，符合線上課程的情境。match（比賽）、lease（租約）、property（財產）不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【時態】The famous athlete ___ three gold medals so far.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。so far（到目前為止）是現在完成式的標誌，主詞 athlete 為單數，因此選 has won。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If our team ___ this match, they will go to the finals.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 引導的子句表未來的可能情況，需用現在簡單式，team 視為單數整體，故選 wins。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The baseball game ___ on television tonight.
normal.explain: 這題測試未來式的被動語態。tonight 表示未來的安排，比賽是被播出的，因此要用 will be shown。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The ___ blew his whistle to stop the players.
normal.explain: 這題測試字彙。referee 指「裁判」，會吹哨子（whistle）停止比賽。assignment（作業）、landlord（房東）、carton（紙箱）皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【時態】The local news channel ___ the election results already.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。already（已經）通常與現在完成式連用。news channel 是單數主詞，搭配 has reported。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If the storm ___ the city, the mayor will close the schools.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 引導的條件子句用現在簡單式，主詞 the storm 是單數，動詞需加 s 變成 hits。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The interview with the singer ___ in the studio yesterday.
normal.explain: 這題測試過去被動語態。時間是 yesterday，訪談（interview）是被拍攝的，因此用 was filmed。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Did you read the main ___ on the front page today?
normal.explain: 這題測試字彙。headline 指「新聞標題」，經常出現在頭版（front page）。其他選項皆不符合語境。

normal.desc: 【時態】The manager ___ the meeting schedule to all staff.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。表示動作已經發生並對現在有影響，單數主詞 manager 搭配 has emailed。

normal.desc: 【條件句】If you ___ the document, the boss will review it tomorrow.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 子句中主詞為 you，動詞需使用現在簡單式的原形 upload。

normal.desc: 【被動語態】The new security rules ___ at the meeting next Friday.
normal.explain: 這題測試未來式的被動語態。時間是 next Friday（下週五），規則是被討論的，因此要用 will be discussed。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Please put the important papers in the correct ___.
normal.explain: 這題測試字彙。folder 指「資料夾」，用來存放文件（papers）。其他選項皆不合理。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the apartment ready for us? 
B: Yes, the cleaning company ___ all the rooms.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。B 的回答表示清潔公司已經完成打掃，結果影響現在公寓的狀態。company 視為單數，用 has cleaned。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: What happens if I want to move out early? 
B: If you ___ the lease early, you will lose some money.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。在 If 引導的條件句中，使用現在簡單式來表示未來的可能動作，因此選 break。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: When can we see the new house? 
B: It ___ by another family right now, so we must wait.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在進行式的被動語態。right now 表示動作正在進行，房子正在「被觀看」，因此用 is being viewed。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Have you finished the writing task? 
B: No, I ___ the essay yet, but I will do it tonight.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。yet 常用於現在完成式的否定句，表示到目前為止尚未完成。主詞 I 搭配 have not written。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Can I watch the lesson on my phone? 
B: Yes, if you ___ the app, you can watch it anywhere.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 子句用現在簡單式，主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 install。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: How will I get my test results? 
B: They ___ to your personal email account next week.
normal.explain: 這題測試未來式的被動語態。成績（they）將在下週被發送，因此用 will be sent。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Who is leading the golf tournament? 
B: David is. He ___ amazing skills since the first round.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。since the first round（自從第一回合開始）表示從過去持續到現在的狀態，因此選 has shown。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Will the tennis match happen today? 
B: No, if it ___, the match will be moved to Sunday.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 子句表示天氣條件時，用現在簡單式，主詞 it 為第三人稱單數，動詞加 s 變成 rains。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Where are the new basketballs? 
B: They ___ in the sports hall by the coach this morning.
normal.explain: 這題測試過去被動語態。時間為 this morning（今天早上，這裡指過去的時間），籃球是被留下的，因此選 were left。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Why is the road closed? 
B: There was a car crash. The police ___ the street.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。警察封鎖了街道，且封鎖的狀態持續到現在。集合名詞 police 習慣作複數看待，因此搭配 have blocked。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did you see the weather report? 
B: Yes, if the temperature ___, it will snow tomorrow.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 條件句使用現在簡單式，主詞 temperature 為單數，因此動詞要用 drops。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Did the mayor give a speech? 
B: Yes, his speech ___ on the radio an hour ago.
normal.explain: 這題測試過去被動語態。an hour ago 是過去時間，演講是被播出的。broadcast 的過去分詞同行，故選 was broadcast。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Where is the boss? 
B: She ___ to London for a business trip.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在完成式。「has gone to」表示已經去了某地，目前人不在這裡。這符合對話中 A 找不到老闆的情境。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Do we need to wear a uniform? 
B: If you ___ in the kitchen, you must wear one.
normal.explain: 這題測試第一類條件句。If 子句中主詞 you 搭配原形動詞 work，用現在簡單式表達真實條件。

normal.desc:
【對話】A: Is the sales report ready? 
B: Not yet. It ___ by the manager right now.
normal.explain: 這題測試現在進行被動語態。right now 表示動作正在進行，報告正在「被檢查」，因此選 is being checked。

normal.desc:
【短文】Housing Message: The water supply in the building will be turned off tomorrow morning. If you need water for cooking, please save some tonight. The pipes will be fixed by the city workers. 
Question: What is the main message for the people living in the building?
options: A. To save water for cooking
C. To buy a new house
D. To call the city workers
normal.explain: 短文中提到「If you need water for cooking, please save some tonight.（如果需要用水煮飯，請在今晚儲水）」，因此主要的訊息是提醒住戶儲水煮飯。

normal.desc:
【短文】Moving Company Email: Dear Sarah, your boxes have arrived at our storage center. They will be delivered to your new apartment on Friday. If you are not home, we will leave them with the security guard. 
Question: What will the company do if Sarah is out?
options: A. Take them back to the center
B. Give them to the guard
normal.explain: 短文清楚指出「If you are not home, we will leave them with the security guard.（如果你不在家，我們會把它們留給警衛）」。

normal.desc:
Manager: "We need to follow up on the customer complaints as soon as possible."
Q: What does "follow up on" mean in this context?
options: C. Take further action or investigate
normal.explain: 片語動詞「follow up on」意為「跟進處理／深入調查後續行動」（take further action）。

normal.desc: 【職場通訊】請唸出工作郵件結尾常見的跟進句：「I will follow up with you tomorrow morning.」
normal.speak: I will follow up with you tomorrow morning
normal.ans: I WILL FOLLOW UP WITH YOU TOMORROW MORNING
normal.explain: 口說表達「I WILL FOLLOW UP WITH YOU TOMORROW MORNING」(phr.)：【職場通訊】請唸出工作郵件結尾常見的跟進句：「I will follow up with you tomorrow morning.」。

normal.desc: 🎧 【修繕通知】請聽大樓管委會廣播並選出停水時間：
normal.speak: Notice to all residents: the water supply will be temporarily shut off tomorrow between 9 AM and 1 PM for maintenance.
normal.explain: 廣播明確指出停水時段為「between 9 AM and 1 PM」（上午9點至下午1點）。

normal.desc:
Email to Landlord: "Dear Mr. Davis, the heating system in unit 302 stopped functioning last night. The temperature inside has dropped below 15 degrees. We appreciate your immediate assistance."
Q: Why is the tenant urgent?
options: A. The apartment has no heat in cold weather.
B. The rent was paid to the wrong account.
C. The tenant wants to move out today.
D. The neighbors are making loud noise.
normal.explain: 房客表示暖氣系統停止運作（heating system stopped functioning），室內溫度已降至 15 度以下，亟需暖氣修復。

normal.desc: 【租約洽詢】請唸出欲續約的商務租屋句：「I would like to renew my rental contract for another year.」
normal.speak: I would like to renew my rental contract for another year
normal.ans: I WOULD LIKE TO RENEW MY RENTAL CONTRACT FOR ANOTHER YEAR
normal.explain: 口說表達「I WOULD LIKE TO RENEW MY RENTAL CONTRACT FOR ANOTHER YEAR」(phr.)：【租約洽詢】請唸出欲續約的商務租屋句：「I would like to renew my rental contract for another year.」。

normal.desc: 【生活單字】租屋簽約時支付的「押金／保證金」（7個字母）：
normal.explain: DEPOSIT (n.)：【生活單字】租屋簽約時支付的「押金／保證金」（7個字母）：。

normal.desc: 🎧 【視訊會議】請聽會議主持人的提醒並回答情境：
normal.speak: David, we cannot hear you right now. I think you are speaking on mute.
options: B. David's webcam is turned off.
D. David forgot to unmute his microphone.
normal.explain: 主持人提到「speaking on mute」，代表戴維忘記解除麥克風靜音（forgot to unmute）。

normal.desc:
Slack Message: "Hey team, let's wrap up our discussion by 3:30 so everyone has time to review the client feedback before the sprint ends."
Q: What does the phrase "wrap up" mean?
options: A. Put in a gift box
normal.explain: 「wrap up」在商務溝通中是非常高頻的片語，意為「結束／收尾」（finish or conclude）。

normal.desc: 【商務會話】請唸出視訊會議共享螢幕的實用語：「Let me share my screen to show the quarterly results.」
normal.speak: Let me share my screen to show the quarterly results
normal.ans: LET ME SHARE MY SCREEN TO SHOW THE QUARTERLY RESULTS
normal.explain: 口說表達「LET ME SHARE MY SCREEN TO SHOW THE QUARTERLY RESULTS」(phr.)：【商務會話】請唸出視訊會議共享螢幕的實用語：「Let me share my screen to show the quarterly results.」。

normal.desc: 【職場單字】專案任務的最後「截止日期」（8個字母）：
normal.explain: DEADLINE (n.)：【職場單字】專案任務的最後「截止日期」（8個字母）：。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: accommodation
boss.explain: 英文原句為 accommodation，意思是「住宿」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: prescription
boss.explain: 英文原句為 prescription，意思是「處方」或「處方箋」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: negotiate
boss.explain: 英文原句為 negotiate，意思是「談判」或「協商」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: scholarship
boss.explain: 英文原句為 scholarship，意思是「獎學金」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: evaluate
boss.explain: 英文原句為 evaluate，意思是「評估」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The performance will be evaluated next month.
options: A. 表現不好會被開除。
C. 這個月的表現很好。
D. 下個月將會評估工作表現。
boss.explain: 英文原句為 The performance will be evaluated next month. 意思是「下個月將會評估工作表現。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you do not take the medicine, the infection will not heal.
options: A. 如果你不吃藥，感染就不會痊癒。
B. 如果你吃藥，感染就會變嚴重。
C. 感染已經因為吃藥而痊癒了。
D. 你必須吃藥才能預防感染。
boss.explain: 英文原句為 If you do not take the medicine, the infection will not heal. 意思是「如果你不吃藥，感染就不會痊癒。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: My luggage has been lost at the airport.
options: A. 我在機場找到了行李。
B. 我的行李在機場遺失了。
C. 我忘記帶行李去機場。
D. 行李在機場被偷了。
boss.explain: 英文原句為 My luggage has been lost at the airport. 意思是「我的行李在機場遺失了。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you negotiated a better price for the accommodation?
options: A. I prefer to stay in a hotel.
C. Yes, I got a ten percent discount.
D. I haven't found a place to stay.
boss.explain: 聽到「你已經為住宿談判到更好的價格了嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我拿到了九折優惠。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you win the scholarship, which university will you choose?
options: A. The university is very famous.
B. I study hard every day.
C. I didn't win the competition.
boss.explain: 聽到「如果你贏得獎學金，你會選擇哪一所大學？」最適合回答「我還沒決定。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the doctor given you a prescription for your cough?
options: A. Yes, I need to go to the pharmacy.
B. The doctor is very professional.
C. My cough is getting worse.
D. I don't have a prescription.
boss.explain: 聽到「醫生已經給你治咳嗽的處方箋了嗎？」最適合回答「是的，我需要去一趟藥局。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the contract is broken, we will take legal action.
options: B. Let's hope they keep their promise.
C. The legal action is expensive.
D. We need to sign a new contract.
boss.explain: 聽到「如果合約被打破，我們將採取法律行動。」最適合回應「希望他們信守承諾。」

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】Not only ___ the new software installed successfully, but it has also increased our work efficiency by 20%.
boss.explain: Not only 置於句首時需倒裝。後半句有 installed (V-p.p.)，軟體是被安裝，需用被動語態的 be 動詞，且動作發生在過去，故選 was (was the new software installed)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】If the board members ___ to the proposed budget, we will start the construction next week.
boss.explain: 第一類條件句中，If 子句即使講述未來的決定，也必須使用現在式。主詞 the board members 為複數，動詞用原形 agree。

boss.desc:
【短文】A new study reveals that commuting for more than one hour daily has been linked to higher stress levels. Researchers suggest that companies offer flexible work hours. 
Question: What is the main finding of the study?
options: A. Commuting is cheap in the city.
B. Long commutes can increase stress.
C. Flexible hours cause lower productivity.
D. Researchers prefer to commute by train.
boss.explain: 文中指出「commuting for more than one hour daily has been linked to higher stress levels」(每天通勤超過一小時與較高壓力有關)，因此 B 是主要發現。

boss.desc:
【短文】To receive a full refund, the item must be returned in its original packaging within 14 days of purchase. Items that have been used or damaged will not be accepted. 
Question: Under what condition will a return NOT be accepted?
options: A. If it is returned within 7 days.
B. If it is in the original packaging.
C. If the item has been damaged.
D. If the customer asks for a refund.
boss.explain: 文中最後一句「Items that have been used or damaged will not be accepted.」明確指出損壞的物品不接受退貨，故選 C。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Our team has been trying to find a better ___ to solve this complex engineering problem.
boss.explain: solution 意為「解決方案」，與後面的 solve this problem 呼應。destination 目的地，refund 退款，accommodation 住宿。

boss.desc:
【短文】The gallery has hosted several modern art exhibitions this year. If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events. 
Question: What is a benefit of the annual membership?
options: A. Free coffee at the museum cafe.
C. You can host your own exhibition.
boss.explain: 文中提到「If you purchase an annual membership, you will be invited to all private gallery events」，意即能受邀參加私人展館活動。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】The new environmental laws ___ by the government to reduce carbon emissions across the country.
boss.explain: 主詞 laws (法律) 是被引入的，需要被動語態，且搭配 recently 通常用現在完成式，故選 have been introduced 的現在完成被動式。

boss.desc: 【片語字彙】The CEO decided to ___ the new strategy instead of sticking to the old business model.
boss.explain: go ahead with 意為「推進、開始執行」。句意為執行新策略以取代舊模式。look forward to 期待，rely on 依賴，stay away from 遠離。

boss.desc:
【短文】Scientists have successfully developed a solar panel that works at night. This invention will significantly change how we use renewable energy. 
Question: What can be inferred about the new solar panel?
options: A. It requires a lot of water to work.
B. It only works when the sun is shining.
C. It generates power even when it is dark.
D. It is too expensive for most people.
boss.explain: 文章說「works at night」(在晚上運作)，這代表即使天黑也能產生能源，故選 C。infer(推論)的考法要求根據內文合理延伸。

boss.desc: 【時態】The financial report ___ to the investors by the time they arrive for the annual meeting tomorrow.
boss.explain: by the time 加上未來的時間點，常搭配未來完成式。報告是「被」寄出，需使用未來完成被動式 will have been sent。雖然難度稍微偏高，但為 B1 上層至 B2 的進階挑戰。

boss.desc:
【短文】As a loyal customer, you have been selected for a free upgrade to our premium internet service. If you accept this offer, your monthly speed will double without any extra charges. 
Question: What will happen if the customer accepts the offer?
options: A. They will have to pay double the price.
B. They will lose their internet connection.
C. Their internet speed will increase by 100%.
D. Their contract will be canceled.
boss.explain: 文中的「your monthly speed will double (速度將翻倍)」意思等同於速度增加 100%，故選 C。且沒有額外收費。

boss.desc: 【字彙】If you are experiencing severe ___, you should consult a medical professional immediately.
boss.explain: severe symptoms 意為「嚴重的症狀」。若經歷嚴重症狀應立即就醫。solutions 解決方案，nutrients 營養素，environments 環境。

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：維護
boss.speak: maintenance
boss.explain: 口說表達「MAINTENANCE」(n.)：維護。例句：The machine needs regular maintenance.（這台機器需要定期維護。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：解決
boss.speak: resolve
boss.explain: 口說表達「RESOLVE」(v.)：解決。例句：We must resolve this issue quickly.（我們必須盡快解決這個問題。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：車輛
boss.speak: vehicle
boss.explain: 口說表達「VEHICLE」(n.)：車輛。例句：You cannot park your vehicle here.（你不能把你的車輛停在這裡。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：升級
boss.speak: upgrade
boss.explain: 口說表達「UPGRADE」(v.)：升級。例句：You can upgrade to first class for free.（你可以免費升等至頭等艙。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：製造
boss.speak: manufacture
boss.explain: 口說表達「MANUFACTURE」(v.)：製造。例句：They manufacture clothes in this factory.（他們在這家工廠製造衣服。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：例行維護
boss.speak: routine maintenance
boss.explain: 口說表達「ROUTINE MAINTENANCE」(phr.)：例行維護。

boss.desc: 請唸出：解決衝突
boss.speak: resolve the conflict
boss.explain: 口說表達「RESOLVE THE CONFLICT」(phr.)：解決衝突。

boss.desc: 請唸出：升級系統
boss.speak: upgrade the system
boss.explain: 口說表達「UPGRADE THE SYSTEM」(phr.)：升級系統。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們已經投資了新科技
boss.ans: WE HAVE INVESTED IN NEW TECHNOLOGY
boss.speak: we have invested in new technology
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE INVESTED IN NEW TECHNOLOGY」(phr.)：我們已經投資了新科技。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果預算足夠我們將升級
boss.ans: IF THE BUDGET IS ENOUGH WE WILL UPGRADE
boss.speak: if the budget is enough we will upgrade
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF THE BUDGET IS ENOUGH WE WILL UPGRADE」(phr.)：如果預算足夠我們將升級。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項策略已經被證明有效
boss.ans: THE STRATEGY HAS BEEN PROVEN EFFECTIVE
boss.speak: the strategy has been proven effective
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE STRATEGY HAS BEEN PROVEN EFFECTIVE」(phr.)：這項策略已經被證明有效。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果客訴沒解決我會離職
boss.ans: IF THE COMPLAINT IS NOT RESOLVED I WILL QUIT
boss.speak: if the complaint is not resolved i will quit
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF THE COMPLAINT IS NOT RESOLVED I WILL QUIT」(phr.)：如果客訴沒解決我會離職。

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ C O M M _ N _ (推薦)
boss.speak: recommend
boss.explain: RECOMMEND (v.)：推薦。填空答案為「EED」。例句：I will recommend this book to my friends.（我將會推薦這本書給我的朋友們。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：投訴
boss.speak: complaint
boss.explain: COMPLAINT (n.)：客訴。例句：We received a complaint from a customer.（我們收到了一位顧客的客訴。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I _ V I T A _ I _ N (邀請)
boss.speak: invitation
boss.explain: INVITATION (n.)：邀請。填空答案為「NTO」。例句：Thank you for the invitation.（謝謝你的邀請。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E X C _ L L _ N _ (優秀的)
boss.speak: excellent
boss.explain: EXCELLENT (adj.)：優秀的。填空答案為「EET」。例句：The food at the party was excellent.（派對上的食物非常棒。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：滿意的
boss.speak: satisfied
boss.explain: SATISFIED (adj.)：滿意的。例句：Customers have been very satisfied with the new product.（顧客對這款新產品一直感到非常滿意。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S _ T _ S F _ E D (滿意的)
boss.speak: satisfied
boss.explain: SATISFIED (adj.)：滿意的。填空答案為「AII」。例句：Customers have been very satisfied with the new product.（顧客對這款新產品一直感到非常滿意。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：成功的
boss.speak: successful
boss.explain: SUCCESSFUL (adj.)：成功的。例句：The event was successfully organized by the team.（這次活動已由團隊成功舉辦。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S U C _ E _ S F U _ (成功的)
boss.speak: successful
boss.explain: SUCCESSFUL (adj.)：成功的。填空答案為「CSL」。例句：The event was successfully organized by the team.（這次活動已由團隊成功舉辦。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：達成
boss.speak: achieve
boss.explain: ACHIEVE (v.)：達成。例句：We aim to achieve our sales goals this year.（我們目標在今年達成銷售目標。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A C H _ _ V _ (達成)
boss.speak: achieve
boss.explain: ACHIEVE (v.)：達成。填空答案為「IEE」。例句：We aim to achieve our sales goals this year.（我們目標在今年達成銷售目標。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：指示
boss.speak: instruction
boss.explain: INSTRUCTION (n.)：指示/說明。例句：The instructions were written in English.（這些說明是以英文撰寫的。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N S T R _ C _ I O _ (指示)
boss.speak: instruction
boss.explain: INSTRUCTION (n.)：指示。填空答案為「UTN」。例句：The instructions were written in English.（這些說明是以英文撰寫的。）

boss.desc:
【短文】The latest headphones have an active noise-canceling function. If you wear them on an airplane, you will not hear the engine sound. 
Question: What is a benefit of the headphones?
options: B. They block out engine noise.
C. They can play music louder.
D. They are easy to carry.
boss.explain: 短文指出戴上這款耳機「you will not hear the engine sound (你就不會聽到引擎聲)」，這表示它們能阻擋噪音，故選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A smart ring was introduced by a tech company last month. It can track your heart rate and sleep patterns. 
Question: What can the smart ring do?
boss.explain: 短文中提到它能「track your heart rate and sleep patterns (追蹤心率與睡眠模式)」，這些皆屬於健康數據 (health data)，故選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Traditional books are still loved by many. However, digital reading has become more common because tablets are easy to carry. 
Question: Why is reading on tablets common?
options: A. They are cheaper than books.
B. They are better for the eyes.
boss.explain: 短文提到平板閱讀變得普遍是因為「tablets are easy to carry (容易攜帶)」，portable 就是易於攜帶之意，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Remote work has changed our daily routines. If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family. 
Question: What is an advantage of not commuting?
boss.explain: 短文提到「If we do not commute, we will have more time to spend with our family (如果不通勤，我們會有更多時間陪家人)」，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】The office layout was redesigned by a famous studio. They added more open spaces so people can talk to each other easily. 
Question: Why did they add open spaces?
options: C. To make the office look larger.
boss.explain: 短文說明增加開放空間是為了「so people can talk to each other easily (讓人們容易交談)」，即鼓勵溝通 (encourage communication)，選 (A)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Your primary task this week is to organize the customer files. If you finish early, please help the design team. 
Question: What should the person do if they complete their work early?
boss.explain: 文中指示「If you finish early, please help the design team (若提早完成，請協助設計團隊)」，Assist the designers 意思與此相符，選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A recent study shows that walking for thirty minutes a day improves heart health. If you exercise regularly, you will feel less tired. 
Question: How long should one walk daily according to the study?
boss.explain: 短文指出需要走路 thirty minutes (30分鐘)。Half an hour 即為半小時（30分鐘），故選 (B)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Green tea is known for its health benefits. It is consumed by millions of people in Asia to help digestion. 
Question: Why do many people drink green tea?
boss.explain: 文中提到「consumed ... to help digestion (飲用以幫助消化)」，assist with digestion 為同義替換，選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】To lose weight, you must burn more calories than you eat. This can be achieved by doing sports like running or swimming. 
Question: How can someone lose weight?
options: D. By using more energy than they consume.
boss.explain: 文中提到必須「burn more calories than you eat (消耗的卡路里要比吃進去的多)」，這等於 using more energy than they consume，故選 (D)。

boss.desc:
【短文】The city has introduced electric buses to reduce air pollution. If more people use them, the air quality will improve significantly. 
Question: What is the purpose of the electric buses?
options: C. To make the air cleaner.
boss.explain: 引進電動公車是為了解決「air pollution (空氣污染)」並改善空氣品質，這與 To make the air cleaner 意義相同，故選 (C)。

boss.desc:
【短文】A new bicycle lane was built near the river. It allows people to ride safely without worrying about cars. 
Question: What is true about the new bicycle lane?
options: A. It keeps riders away from cars.
B. It is only for walking.
C. It is located near the mountain.
D. It was built five years ago.
boss.explain: 短文指出新車道讓騎士「without worrying about cars (不用擔心汽車)」，意即可以避開車輛 (keeps riders away from cars)，選 (A)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Traffic congestion is a major issue during rush hours. The government plans to build another subway line to solve this. 
Question: How will the government handle the heavy traffic?
options: B. By constructing a new train system.
boss.explain: 文中政府的解決方案是「build another subway line (建造另一條地鐵線)」，這與 constructing a new train system 意思一致，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果我們不現在採取行動，就會太遲了。
boss.ans: IF WE DO NOT ACT NOW IT WILL BE TOO LATE
boss.speak: if we do not act now it will be too late
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF WE DO NOT ACT NOW IT WILL BE TOO LATE」(phr.)：如果我們不現在採取行動，就會太遲了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這個提議已經被委員會拒絕了。
boss.ans: THE PROPOSAL HAS BEEN REJECTED BY THE COMMITTEE
boss.speak: the proposal has been rejected by the committee
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE PROPOSAL HAS BEEN REJECTED BY THE COMMITTEE」(phr.)：這個提議已經被委員會拒絕了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：雖然有風險，但我認為這是值得的。
boss.ans: ALTHOUGH THERE IS A RISK I THINK IT IS WORTH IT
boss.speak: although there is a risk i think it is worth it
boss.explain: 口說表達「ALTHOUGH THERE IS A RISK I THINK IT IS WORTH IT」(phr.)：雖然有風險，但我認為這是值得的。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們必須確保客戶的抱怨得到妥善處理。
boss.ans: WE MUST ENSURE CUSTOMER COMPLAINTS ARE HANDLED WELL
boss.speak: we must ensure customer complaints are handled well
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE MUST ENSURE CUSTOMER COMPLAINTS ARE HANDLED WELL」(phr.)：我們必須確保客戶的抱怨得到妥善處理。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果他們提出更好的條件，我們就接受。
boss.ans: IF THEY OFFER BETTER CONDITIONS WE WILL ACCEPT
boss.speak: if they offer better conditions we will accept
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF THEY OFFER BETTER CONDITIONS WE WILL ACCEPT」(phr.)：如果他們提出更好的條件，我們就接受。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這幾個月來，我們已經取得了很大的進展。
boss.ans: WE HAVE MADE A LOT OF PROGRESS IN RECENT MONTHS
boss.speak: we have made a lot of progress in recent months
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE MADE A LOT OF PROGRESS IN RECENT MONTHS」(phr.)：這幾個月來，我們已經取得了很大的進展。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我很抱歉，但我無法同意這個解決方案。
boss.ans: I AM SORRY BUT I CANNOT AGREE WITH THIS SOLUTION
boss.speak: i am sorry but i cannot agree with this solution
boss.explain: 口說表達「I AM SORRY BUT I CANNOT AGREE WITH THIS SOLUTION」(phr.)：我很抱歉，但我無法同意這個解決方案。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項計畫如果沒有你們的幫助就不會成功。
boss.ans: THE PROJECT WILL NOT SUCCEED WITHOUT YOUR HELP
boss.speak: the project will not succeed without your help
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE PROJECT WILL NOT SUCCEED WITHOUT YOUR HELP」(phr.)：這項計畫如果沒有你們的幫助就不會成功。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們已經比較過所有的選項，這是最好的。
boss.ans: WE HAVE COMPARED ALL OPTIONS AND THIS IS THE BEST
boss.speak: we have compared all options and this is the best
boss.explain: 口說表達「WE HAVE COMPARED ALL OPTIONS AND THIS IS THE BEST」(phr.)：我們已經比較過所有的選項，這是最好的。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：新政策將在下個月由管理層實施。
boss.ans: THE NEW POLICY WILL BE IMPLEMENTED BY MANAGEMENT NEXT MONTH
boss.speak: the new policy will be implemented by management next month
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE NEW POLICY WILL BE IMPLEMENTED BY MANAGEMENT NEXT MONTH」(phr.)：新政策將在下個月由管理層實施。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果預算被批准，我們將開始下一個階段。
boss.ans: IF THE BUDGET IS APPROVED WE WILL START THE NEXT PHASE
boss.speak: if the budget is approved we will start the next phase
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF THE BUDGET IS APPROVED WE WILL START THE NEXT PHASE」(phr.)：如果預算被批准，我們將開始下一個階段。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這是我人生中做過最困難的決定。
boss.ans: THIS IS THE MOST DIFFICULT DECISION I HAVE MADE IN MY LIFE
boss.speak: this is the most difficult decision i have made in my life
boss.explain: 口說表達「THIS IS THE MOST DIFFICULT DECISION I HAVE MADE IN MY LIFE」(phr.)：這是我人生中做過最困難的決定。。

boss.desc: 請拼出：感到失望的
boss.speak: disappointed
boss.explain: DISAPPOINTED (adj.)：失望的；沮喪的。例句：We were very disappointed because the outdoor performance was canceled.（因為戶外演出被取消，我們當時感到非常失望。）

boss.desc: 填空題：D I _ A P P O I _ T _ D (感到失望的)
boss.speak: disappointed
boss.explain: DISAPPOINTED (adj.)：感到失望的。填空答案為「SNE」。例句：We were very disappointed because the outdoor performance was canceled.（因為戶外演出被取消，我們當時感到非常失望。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：機會
boss.speak: opportunity
boss.explain: OPPORTUNITY (n.)：機會。例句：I have waited for this career opportunity for years.（我已經等這個職業機會好幾年了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：O P P _ R T _ N I _ _ (機會)
boss.speak: opportunity
boss.explain: OPPORTUNITY (n.)：機會。填空答案為「OUTY」。例句：I have waited for this career opportunity for years.（我已經等這個職業機會好幾年了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：表現
boss.speak: performance
boss.explain: PERFORMANCE (n.)：請拼出：表現。

boss.desc: 填空題：P E R F _ R M A N _ _ (表現)
boss.speak: performance
boss.explain: PERFORMANCE (n.)：表現。填空答案為「OCE」。

boss.desc: 請拼出：情況
boss.speak: situation
boss.explain: SITUATION (n.)：情況；處境。例句：I have never been in this kind of situation before.（我以前從未經歷過這種情況。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S _ T U _ T I O _ (情況)
boss.speak: situation
boss.explain: SITUATION (n.)：情況。填空答案為「IAN」。例句：I have never been in this kind of situation before.（我以前從未經歷過這種情況。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：道歉
boss.speak: apologize
boss.explain: APOLOGIZE (v.)：道歉。例句：I must apologize to him.（我必須向他道歉。）

boss.desc: 填空題：A P _ L O _ I _ E (道歉)
boss.speak: apologize
boss.explain: APOLOGIZE (v.)：道歉。填空答案為「OGZ」。例句：I must apologize to him.（我必須向他道歉。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：鼓勵
boss.speak: encourage
boss.explain: ENCOURAGE (v.)：鼓勵。例句：My boss has always encouraged me to learn more skills.（我的老闆一直鼓勵我學習更多技能。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E N _ O U R _ G _ (鼓勵)
boss.speak: encourage
boss.explain: ENCOURAGE (v.)：鼓勵。填空答案為「CAE」。例句：My boss has always encouraged me to learn more skills.（我的老闆一直鼓勵我學習更多技能。）

boss.desc: 填空題：E X P _ E _ _ (表達)
boss.speak: express
boss.explain: EXPRESS (v.)：表達。填空答案為「RSS」。例句：Many customers have expressed their satisfaction.（許多顧客已經表達了他們的滿意。）

boss.desc: 填空題：F _ C I _ I T _ (設施)
boss.speak: facility
boss.explain: FACILITY (n.)：設施。填空答案為「ALY」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: adjust
boss.explain: 原字為 adjust (v.)，意思是「調整」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: attend
boss.explain: 原字為 attend (v.)，意思是「出席、參加」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: venue
boss.explain: 原字為 venue (n.)，意思是「場地」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: emergency
boss.explain: 原字為 emergency (n.)，意思是「緊急情況」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: purchase
boss.explain: 原字為 purchase (v./n.)，意思是「購買」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you have the qualification, you will get the job.
options: A. 你已經得到這份工作了。
B. 你的資格不符合這份工作。
C. 就算有資格也不一定能得到工作。
D. 如果你有資格，你就會得到這份工作。
boss.explain: 原句：If you have the qualification, you will get the job. 意思是「如果你有資格，你就會得到這份工作。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: My body temperature has been measured twice.
options: A. 我的體溫已經被量過兩次了。
D. 我的體溫還沒有被量過。
boss.explain: 原句：My body temperature has been measured twice. 意思是「我的體溫已經被量過兩次了。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If he rests well, he will recover quickly.
options: A. 他因為沒有休息所以恢復得很慢。
B. 如果他好好休息，他會恢復得很快。
C. 即使他休息了，也無法恢復。
D. 他已經恢復得很快了。
boss.explain: 原句：If he rests well, he will recover quickly. 意思是「如果他好好休息，他會恢復得很快。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The venue has been selected for our gathering.
options: A. 我們的聚會取消了場地。
B. 我們還沒找到聚會的場地。
C. 我們聚會的場地已經被選定了。
D. 場地對我們的聚會來說太小了。
boss.explain: 原句：The venue has been selected for our gathering. 意思是「我們聚會的場地已經被選定了。」

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you ever bought a faulty item online?
options: A. I buy things online all the time.
B. The product is not faulty.
C. Yes, I will buy it online.
D. Yes, I once received a broken cup.
boss.explain: 原句：Have you ever bought a faulty item online? (你曾在網路上買過有瑕疵的物品嗎？) (A) 我經常上網買東西。(B) 產品沒有瑕疵。(C) 是的，我會上網買。(D) 是的，我有一次收到破掉的杯子。故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If they change the topic, what will we talk about?
options: A. We will just follow their new direction.
B. The topic is very interesting.
C. They haven't changed the topic.
D. Yes, we will talk about the topic.
boss.explain: 原句：If they change the topic, what will we talk about? (如果他們改變主題，我們將談論什麼？) (A) 我們就跟隨他們的新方向。(B) 這主題很有趣。(C) 他們還沒改主題。(D) 是的，我們會談論這主題。故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the background check been finished by the company?
options: A. The company has a good background.
B. Not yet, they are still checking my history.
C. Yes, the background check will finish soon.
D. I have finished the company check.
boss.explain: 原句：Has the background check been finished by the company? (公司完成背景調查了嗎？) (A) 公司背景良好。(B) 還沒，他們還在查我的經歷。(C) 背景調查很快會完成。(D) 我已經完成公司調查。故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【時態】He ___ any new clothes since he started his minimalist lifestyle last year.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗現在完成式的否定型態。關鍵字 since (自從) 接過去時間，表示從去年開始直到現在都「沒有買」新衣服，必須使用現在完成式，故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【條件句】The ocean will become more polluted if we ___ the use of plastic bottles.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗第一類條件句。主要子句使用未來式 (will become)，If 條件子句應使用現在簡單式代替未來式。依照語意「如果我們不減少使用塑膠瓶」，故選 (C) don't reduce。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】All the final essays must ___ by Friday evening, or the teacher will not grade them.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：本題測驗助動詞的被動語態。主詞為 essays (論文)，無法自己完成動作，必須被完成。助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞 be 加上過去分詞 (V-en)，故選 (D) be finished。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Finding cheap ___ in this popular tourist city can be very difficult during the summer.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。在旅遊熱門城市，夏天要找到便宜的「住宿 (accommodation)」是很困難的。選項 (B) 溝通，(C) 對話，(D) 展覽，皆不符句意。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The government has started a new ___ project to protect the rare birds in the mountains.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗名詞字彙。為了保護稀有鳥類，政府啟動了新的「保育 (conservation)」計畫。注意不要與選項 (A) conversation (對話) 混淆。

boss.desc: 【短文】To encourage eco-friendly shopping, the grocery store is offering a special promotion. If you bring your own reusable bags, a small amount of money is deducted from your total bill. Many shoppers have praised this clever idea. Question: How does the store reward eco-friendly shoppers?
options: A. By giving them free reusable bags
B. By praising them on social media
C. By taking a little money off their bill
D. By offering them free groceries
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文推論。文中提到 money is deducted from your total bill (從帳單中扣除一小筆錢)，與選項 (C) taking a little money off their bill 意義完全相同。

boss.desc: 【短文】A fitness tracker is worn on the wrist to monitor physical activity. It counts your steps and estimates the calories you have burned. If you connect it to your phone, you will see a detailed chart of your daily progress. Question: How can a user view a detailed chart of their progress?
options: A. By pressing the button on the tracker
B. By visiting the doctor every day
C. By counting their steps carefully
D. By linking the device to a smartphone
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文細節。文章說明 If you connect it to your phone, you will see a detailed chart (如果連接手機，就可以看到詳細圖表)，link the device (連結裝置) 即為 connect 的同義改寫，故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Distance learning allows you to study from anywhere in the world. However, it requires a lot of self-discipline. If you do not plan your schedule well, you will easily fall behind in your classes. Question: What is a disadvantage of distance learning mentioned in the text?
options: A. It is easy to fall behind if you are not organized.
B. It costs a lot more than regular classes.
C. The teachers are usually very strict.
D. You have to travel a lot to take exams.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗主旨推論。文中指出遠距教學需要自律，如果不妥善規劃時間就會落後 (fall behind)，選項 (A) 中 not organized (沒有組織/規劃) 完美對應文意。

boss.desc: 【短文】In Spain, taking a short nap after lunch, known as a siesta, was once very common. Today, modern work schedules have changed this habit. Most businesses in big cities are no longer closed in the afternoon. Question: What has changed about the siesta in modern Spain?
options: A. It has become popular all over the world.
B. It is less common because of modern work hours.
C. It is only practiced by people in big cities.
D. It has been completely forbidden by the law.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文推論。文中提到現代的上班時間改變了午睡習慣，多數大城市商家下午不再關門，這代表午睡習慣因為工作時間變得較不普及，故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Coral reefs are often called the rainforests of the sea because they are home to thousands of species. Sadly, they are threatened by warming waters. If the temperature rises further, many corals will die. Question: Why are coral reefs compared to rainforests?
options: A. Because they need a lot of fresh rain
B. Because they are located near the equator
C. Because they support a wide variety of life
D. Because they have green plants growing on them
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗推論理解。文章首句提到珊瑚礁被稱為海中的雨林，是因為 they are home to thousands of species (是成千上萬物種的家)，表示其生態豐富度高，與選項 (C) support a wide variety of life 意思相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Buying items in bulk can seem like a great way to save cash. However, if you buy too much fresh food, it might go bad before you can eat it. You should only buy dry goods like rice and pasta in large quantities. Question: What is the text's advice on buying things in bulk?
options: A. Always buy fresh food in large amounts.
B. Stop buying bulk items to save space.
C. Only buy things that are on sale today.
D. Limit bulk purchases to dry foods that last longer.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文主旨。文章建議生鮮食品買太多會壞掉，所以應該只大量購買米和義大利麵等乾貨。選項 (D) 限制大量購買僅限於保存較久的乾貨，最符合文意。

boss.desc: 【短文】Language barriers can be challenging when you travel alone. A simple translation app on your phone can solve most communication problems. If you learn a few basic greetings, the locals will be very friendly to you. Question: How should a traveler make a good impression on locals?
options: A. By learning some simple local greetings
B. By traveling with a large group of people
C. By buying them a new smartphone
D. By speaking English very slowly
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文細節。文章提到 If you learn a few basic greetings, the locals will be very friendly (如果你學幾句基本的問候語，當地人會對你很友善)，故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Adults returning to education often worry about their ability to learn new things. Research shows that older brains are actually better at connecting different ideas. If you take your time, you will find that learning is a lifelong joy. Question: What advantage do older learners have according to research?
options: A. They learn to use new computers much faster.
B. They are better at linking various concepts together.
C. They do not need to study as much as young people.
D. They have more free time to attend classes.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：測驗短文細節。文中提到 older brains are actually better at connecting different ideas (較年長的大腦其實更擅長連結不同的想法)，connecting ideas 的同義改寫即為 linking concepts，故選 (B)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the rent been paid by your roommate?
options: A. No, he will transfer the money tomorrow.
B. The dog is barking loudly.
C. I want to buy a new computer.
boss.explain: 原句為「你的室友已經付房租了嗎？」選項 A「沒有，他明天會轉帳」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the coach changes the players, will we win?
options: A. She is reading a book.
B. I am not sure, but it might help.
boss.explain: 原句為「如果教練更換球員，我們會贏嗎？」選項 B「我不確定，但可能會有幫助」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The academic calendar has been updated by the university.
options: A. 大學已經取消了學術會議
B. 大學已經更新了行事曆
C. 教授已經更改了考試時間
D. 學生已經收到了成績單
boss.explain: 原句為「大學已經更新了行事曆。」（The academic calendar has been updated by the university.）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the storm hits the coast, many flights will be delayed.
options: A. 如果暴風雨侵襲海岸，許多航班將會延誤
B. 如果颱風轉向，我們就可以搭飛機
C. 如果下大雨，火車將會停駛
D. 如果風勢太大，機場將會關閉
boss.explain: 原句為「如果暴風雨侵襲海岸，許多航班將會延誤。」（If the storm hits the coast, many flights will be delayed.）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you packed your suitcase for the trip to Europe?
options: C. Almost, I just need to pack my shoes.
D. The museum is very old.
boss.explain: 原句為「你已經為去歐洲的旅行打包好行李箱了嗎？」選項 C「差不多了，我只需要把鞋子放進去」最合適。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the roof leaks again, we will call the repairman.
options: A. That sounds like a good plan.
B. I do not like eating cake.
boss.explain: 原句為「如果屋頂又漏水，我們會打電話給修理工。」選項 A「聽起來是個好計畫」最適合。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The final score has been confirmed by the referee.
options: A. 教練已經對最終比分提出抗議
B. 裁判已經確認了最終比分
C. 球員對最終比分感到不滿
D. 觀眾已經知道了比賽結果
boss.explain: 原句為「裁判已經確認了最終比分。」（The final score has been confirmed by the referee.）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you are absent from the exam, you will get a zero.
options: A. 如果你在考試中作弊，你將會被當掉
B. 如果你沒有準備考試，你會考得很差
C. 如果你缺席考試，你將會得到零分
D. 如果你考試遲到，你將無法進入教室
boss.explain: 原句為「如果你缺席考試，你將會得到零分。」（If you are absent from the exam, you will get a zero.）。absent 意為缺席。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the weather forecast predicted snow for tomorrow?
options: A. Yes, they said it will snow heavily.
B. The dog is playing outside.
C. I need to wash my car.
D. The book is very thick.
boss.explain: 原句為「天氣預報預測明天會下雪嗎？」選項 A「是的，他們說會下大雪」為最佳回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the hotel loses our reservation, where will we stay?
options: A. We can try the hostel across the street.
C. The airplane is flying high.
boss.explain: 原句為「如果飯店弄丟了我們的預訂，我們要住哪裡？」選項 A「我們可以試試對面的青年旅館」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The neighborhood has been improved a lot.
options: A. 鄰居變得非常友善
B. 鄰近的社區已經改善了許多
C. 附近的公園已經建好了
D. 這條街道變得非常吵雜
boss.explain: 原句為「鄰近的社區已經改善了許多。」（The neighborhood has been improved a lot.）。neighborhood 指鄰近地區或社區。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the athletes practice hard, they will win the cup.

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The interest rate has been lowered by the central bank.
options: A. The bank is not open on Sundays.
B. Does that mean our loan will be cheaper?
C. I have not checked my balance yet.
D. Central park is a great place to visit.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The interest rate has been lowered by the central bank. 意思：中央銀行已經調降了利率。選項 (B)「那表示我們的貸款會變便宜嗎？」最符合邏輯。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you lose your debit card, the account will be frozen.
options: A. I will report it immediately if it happens.
B. The weather has been freezing lately.
C. My account has a lot of money in it.
D. I have never used an ATM before.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If you lose your debit card, the account will be frozen. 意思：如果你弄丟了簽帳金融卡，帳戶將會被凍結。選項 (A)「如果發生這種事，我會立刻掛失」最適合。（If 第一類條件句與被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the roof is not fixed, we will move out.
options: A. We can move the furniture later.
B. I will call the worker right now.
C. The roof looks beautiful in this color.
D. Moving to a new city is exciting.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the roof is not fixed, we will move out. 意思：如果屋頂不修好，我們就要搬走。選項 (B)「我現在就打給工人」最適合。（If 第一類條件句與被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you break the rules, you will lose your deposit.
options: A. I promise I will follow all the rules.
B. The bank deposit has been made.
C. The rules are not written down clearly.
D. I have already lost my keys.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If you break the rules, you will lose your deposit. 意思：如果你破壞規定，你將會失去你的押金。選項 (A)「我保證我會遵守所有規定」最適合。（If 第一類條件句）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the heater is broken, it must be repaired today.
options: A. I have broken a glass by accident.
B. It is too hot to turn on the heater.
C. The repairman said he would come at noon.
D. I will buy a new pair of shoes.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the heater is broken, it must be repaired today. 意思：如果暖氣壞了，今天就必須修理。選項 (C)「修理工說他中午會來」最適合。（If 第一類條件句與被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the wrong shoes been returned to the store?
options: A. Yes, my sister took them back yesterday.
B. No, the shoes are very comfortable.
C. Yes, they sell many beautiful clothes.
D. No, I have never been to that store.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have the wrong shoes been returned to the store? 意思：送錯的鞋子已經退回商店了嗎？選項 (A)「是的，我妹妹昨天拿回去了」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The missing parts have not been delivered yet.
options: A. I have missed the train this morning.
B. Maybe we should track the order online.
C. The delivery man is very polite.
D. All the parts are working fine.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The missing parts have not been delivered yet. 意思：缺少的零件還沒送達。選項 (B)「也許我們應該在網路上追蹤訂單」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you been charged twice for the same dress?
options: A. I usually wear a dress to the party.
B. The battery needs to be charged.
C. Yes, I will call their customer service.
D. No, I bought two dresses instead.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have you been charged twice for the same dress? 意思：同一件洋裝你被扣款兩次了嗎？選項 (C)「是的，我會打給他們的客服」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

B. Yes, the car is ready to go now.
C. The road is very flat and wide.
D. No, he hasn't checked the engine.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has the flat tire been changed by the mechanic? 意思：爆胎的輪胎已經被技工換好了嗎？選項 (B)「是的，車子現在可以開了」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you noticed any strange noise from the engine?

B. Yes, the music is a bit too loud.
C. I have not noticed the weather change.
D. The engine is quite new.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have you noticed any strange noise from the engine? 意思：你有注意到引擎發出什麼奇怪的聲音嗎？選項 (A)「沒有，聽起來完全正常」最適合。（現在完成式）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has her grade been talked about during the meeting?
options: A. Yes, the teacher said she has improved a lot.
B. No, I do not like to talk to strangers.
C. Yes, she graded all the papers last night.
D. The meeting room is on the second floor.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has her grade been talked about during the meeting? 意思：在會議中談到她的成績了嗎？選項 (A)「有，老師說她進步了很多」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the school schedule for next semester been released?
options: A. I have a very busy schedule today.
B. Yes, it was posted on the website yesterday.
C. The school is far from my house.
D. Next semester will begin in September.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has the school schedule for next semester been released? 意思：下學期的學校行事曆發布了嗎？選項 (B)「是的，昨天發布在網站上了」最適合。（現在完成式被動語態）
