C. 這幅古老的畫作已經被藝術家們小心翼翼地修復了。
D. 如果你不小心，這幅畫將會被破壞。
boss.explain: The ancient painting has been carefully restored by artists. (這幅古老的畫作已經被藝術家們小心翼翼地修復了。) restore 意為修復，配合被動語態。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the media rights been bought by the network?
options: A. The camera is out of battery.
B. I read the news online yesterday.
C. The broadcast will start in five minutes.
D. Yes, they signed the deal yesterday.
boss.explain: Have the media rights been bought by the network? (媒體版權已經被廣播網買下了嗎？) 回答 D (是的，他們昨天簽約了) 最符合商業情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the mental pressure is too high, she will quit the job.
options: A. 如果心理壓力太大，她將會辭去這份工作。
B. 她已經克服了工作上的壓力。
C. 心理醫生建議她換一個環境。
D. 辭職是一個很困難的決定。
boss.explain: If the mental pressure is too high, she will quit the job. (如果心理壓力太大，她將會辭去這份工作。) 考查條件句與 pressure (壓力)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The dairy section has been moved.
options: A. 超市今天提早關門。
B. 乳製品區已經被移動了。
C. 這些牛奶非常新鮮。
D. 請在前面的走道右轉。
boss.explain: The dairy section has been moved. (乳製品區已經被移動了。) dairy 意為乳製品，為超市常見分類。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you mix the ingredients well, the flavor will be amazing.
options: A. 廚房裡有很多新鮮的蔬菜。
B. 這些香料是從國外進口的。
C. 如果你把這些食材混合均勻，味道將會非常棒。
D. 這道菜的烹飪時間大約是一小時。
boss.explain: If you mix the ingredients well, the flavor will be amazing. (如果你把這些食材混合均勻，味道將會非常棒。) 考查 ingredient (食材/成分)。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The questions have not been prepared.
options: A. 請問你有任何問題嗎？
B. 面試將在明天舉行。
C. 我已經準備好回答了。
D. 這些問題還沒有被準備好。
boss.explain: The questions have not been prepared. (這些問題還沒有被準備好。) 考查現在完成式的被動語態與 prepare。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the new cafeteria rule been published?
options: A. Yes, it was posted on the bulletin board.
B. The food is very expensive here.
C. I will bring my own lunch tomorrow.
D. The chef has worked in a famous restaurant.
boss.explain: Has the new cafeteria rule been published? (新的員工餐廳規定已經公布了嗎？) 回答 A 表示已經貼在佈告欄上了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the cashier is busy, please use the self-service machine.
options: A. The money has been transferred.
B. Thanks, I'll go scan my items there.
C. The machine is broken again.
D. I have never worked as a cashier.
boss.explain: If the cashier is busy, please use the self-service machine. (如果收銀員在忙，請使用自助服務機。) 回應 B (謝謝，我去那邊掃描商品) 最符合購物情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The guided walk has been postponed until tomorrow morning.
options: A. 導遊將會帶我們參觀城市。
B. 昨天的步行非常累人。
C. 導覽步行已經被延後到明天早上。
D. 如果明天下雨，活動將會取消。
boss.explain: The guided walk has been postponed until tomorrow morning. (導覽步行已經被延後到明天早上。) postpone (延後) 為 B1 實用單字。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the mental benefits of yoga been proven?
options: A. The gym is located downtown.
B. I bought a new yoga mat online.
C. The teacher will be late today.
D. Yes, numerous studies show it reduces stress.
boss.explain: Have the mental benefits of yoga been proven? (瑜珈對心理的益處已經被證實了嗎？) 回答 D (是的，許多研究顯示它能減輕壓力) 最具邏輯性。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If you consume too much caffeine, your heart will beat fast.
options: A. 如果你攝取過多咖啡因，你的心跳將會變快。
B. 這杯咖啡的味道非常濃郁。
C. 醫生建議晚上不要喝茶。
D. 咖啡因可以幫助你保持清醒。
boss.explain: If you consume too much caffeine, your heart will beat fast. (如果你攝取過多咖啡因，你的心跳將會變快。) 考查 caffeine 與條件句。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The weekly newsletter has been sent to all subscribers.
options: A. The mail carrier arrived at noon.
B. Great, let's check the open rate later.
C. I don't know how to write an article.
D. The newspaper is on the table.
boss.explain: The weekly newsletter has been sent to all subscribers. (每週電子報已經寄給所有訂閱者了。) 回答 B (太好了，我們晚點來檢查開信率) 符合職場對話。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】 The new marketing STRATEGY ___ carefully by the head of the team.
boss.explain: The new marketing STRATEGY ___ carefully by the head of the team. 策略是被計畫的，選 A。

boss.desc: 【條件句】 If you finish your PREPARATION early, you ___ well in the interview.
boss.explain: If you finish your PREPARATION early, you ___ well in the interview. 條件句未來式，選 C。

boss.desc: 填空題：E N V I _ O N M _ N _ (環境)
boss.speak: environment
boss.explain: ENVIRONMENT (n.)：環境。填空答案為「RET」。例句：The eco-friendly company protected the natural forest environment last year.（這家注重環保的企業去年大力保護了天然的森林環境。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P _ L L _ T I O _ (污染)
boss.speak: pollution
boss.explain: POLLUTION (n.)：污染。填空答案為「OUN」。例句：Air pollution will cause serious health problems.（空氣污染將會造成嚴重的健康問題。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：預訂
boss.speak: reservation
boss.explain: RESERVATION (n.)：預先訂妥座位或房間的安排。例句：Our reservation is for six thirty.（我們預訂六點半。）

boss.desc: 填空題：R _ S _ R V A T I O _ (預訂)
boss.speak: reservation
boss.explain: RESERVATION (n.)：預訂。填空答案為「EEN」。例句：Our reservation is for six thirty.（我們預訂六點半。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：必要的
boss.speak: necessary
boss.explain: NECESSARY (adj.)：必要的。例句：It has become necessary to update our systems.（更新我們的系統已經變得必要了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：N _ C _ S S A R _ (必要的)
boss.speak: necessary
boss.explain: NECESSARY (adj.)：必要的。填空答案為「EEY」。例句：It has become necessary to update our systems.（更新我們的系統已經變得必要了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：準備
boss.speak: preparation
boss.explain: PREPARATION (n.)：準備。例句：Preparations have been completed for the meeting.（會議的準備工作已經完成了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：P R _ P A R _ T I O _ (準備)
boss.speak: preparation
boss.explain: PREPARATION (n.)：準備。填空答案為「EAN」。例句：Preparations have been completed for the meeting.（會議的準備工作已經完成了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：保證
boss.speak: guarantee
boss.explain: GUARANTEE (v.)：保證。例句：We guarantee the quality of our products.（我們保證產品的品質。）

boss.desc: 填空題：G _ A R A N T _ _ (保證)
boss.speak: guarantee
boss.explain: GUARANTEE (v.)：保證。填空答案為「UEE」。例句：We guarantee the quality of our products.（我們保證產品的品質。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：特別地
boss.speak: especially
boss.explain: ESPECIALLY (adv.)：特別地。例句：She has always loved traveling, especially in winter.（她一直很喜歡旅行，特別是在冬天。）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The pilot has not received the permission to take off yet.
options: A. 塔台尚未發出降落的指令。
B. 機長尚未收到起飛的許可。
C. 空服員尚未完成安全檢查。
D. 乘客尚未繫好安全帶。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The pilot has not received the permission to take off yet. 意思：機長尚未收到起飛的許可。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The presentation slides will be shared after the class.
options: A. 上課前的講義將會被收回。
B. 課程大綱將會在課堂上發放。
C. 簡報投影片將會在課後被分享。
D. 測驗卷將會在下課前被批改。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The presentation slides will be shared after the class. 意思：簡報投影片將會在課後被分享。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the construction is not finished, the road will remain single-lane.
options: A. 如果天氣不好，工程將會暫停。
B. 如果預算不足，道路將無法拓寬。
C. 如果抗議不斷，施工將會延後。
D. 如果施工沒有完成，道路將維持單線道。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the construction is not finished, the road will remain single-lane. 意思：如果施工沒有完成，道路將維持單線道。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If your carry-on bag is too heavy, it must be checked in.
options: A. How much extra will that cost me?
B. I have found my lost baggage.
C. The bag has been carried by my friend.
D. If it is light, I will check it in.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If your carry-on bag is too heavy, it must be checked in. 意思：如果你的隨身行李太重，就必須托運。回應「那會花我多少額外費用？」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have the training certificates been printed out?
options: A. The printer is broken today.
B. Yes, they have been placed on your desk.
C. If you pass the test, you will get one.
D. No, the training has not started.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Have the training certificates been printed out? 意思：培訓證書已經印出來了嗎？回應「是的，已經放在你的桌上了。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The speed limit has been reduced to forty on this street.
options: A. The car has been repaired yesterday.
B. I have driven for forty minutes.
C. Thanks for telling me. I will slow down.
D. If you speed up, you will arrive on time.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The speed limit has been reduced to forty on this street. 意思：這條街的速限已經降到四十了。回應「謝謝你告訴我。我會減速。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I have suffered from a terrible backache since yesterday morning.
options: A. Your back has been protected.
B. If you hurt your back, you will cry.
C. The medicine has been finished.
D. You should take a rest and see a doctor.
boss.explain: 英文原句：I have suffered from a terrible backache since yesterday morning. 意思：自從昨天早上，我就深受可怕的背痛所苦。回應「你應該休息一下並去看醫生。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If you order the set meal, you will get a free dessert.
options: A. Great! What kind of dessert is it?
B. The meal has been paid by credit card.
C. If I eat dessert, I will be full.
D. The chef has prepared the soup.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If you order the set meal, you will get a free dessert. 意思：如果你點套餐，就會獲得一份免費甜點。回應「太棒了！是哪種甜點呢？」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The lost passport has been found by a cleaner in the restroom.
options: A. If I lose my passport, I will be nervous.
B. That is a relief! Where can the owner pick it up?
C. The restroom has been cleaned already.
D. She has not traveled abroad yet.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The lost passport has been found by a cleaner in the restroom. 意思：遺失的護照已經被清潔工在洗手間找到了。回應「那真是鬆了一口氣！失主可以在哪裡領取？」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If we finish the group discussion early, can we leave?
options: A. The group has been divided into two.
B. We have discussed this issue before.
C. No, you must wait for the final review.
D. If we leave, the door will be locked.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If we finish the group discussion early, can we leave? 意思：如果我們提早完成小組討論，可以離開嗎？回應「不行，你們必須留下來等最後的檢討。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the heavy fog affected the highway traffic?
options: B. If you drive in the fog, you must turn on the lights.
C. The highway has been built recently.
D. Yes, several cars have crashed due to poor sight.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Has the heavy fog affected the highway traffic? 意思：大霧有影響高速公路交通嗎？回應「是的，有幾輛車因為視線不良而相撞了。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The vitamins should be taken after breakfast.
options: A. Okay, I will swallow them with some water later.
B. Breakfast has been eaten by my brother.
C. If you take vitamins, you will be smart.
D. The medicine has been thrown away.
boss.explain: 英文原句：The vitamins should be taken after breakfast. 意思：維他命應該在早餐後服用。回應「好的，我等一下會配點水吞下去。」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the customer asks for a discount, how should I answer?
options: A. The discount has been given to him.
B. Tell them the promotion only applies to VIP members.
C. If I give a discount, my boss will be happy.
D. The bill has been calculated correctly.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the customer asks for a discount, how should I answer? 意思：如果顧客要求折扣，我該怎麼回答？回應「告訴他們促銷活動只適用於VIP會員。」最合理。

boss.desc: 請唸出：房間還沒有被打掃。
boss.ans: THE ROOM HAS NOT BEEN CLEANED
boss.speak: the room has not been cleaned
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ROOM HAS NOT BEEN CLEANED」(phr.)：房間還沒有被打掃。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果非常吵雜我會客訴。
boss.ans: IF IT IS VERY NOISY I WILL COMPLAIN
boss.speak: if it is very noisy i will complain
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF IT IS VERY NOISY I WILL COMPLAIN」(phr.)：如果非常吵雜我會客訴。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：檔案已經被整理好了。
boss.speak: the files have been organized
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE FILES HAVE BEEN ORGANIZED」(phr.)：檔案已經被整理好了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果你嘗試你就會進步。
boss.ans: IF YOU TRY YOU WILL IMPROVE
boss.speak: if you try you will improve
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF YOU TRY YOU WILL IMPROVE」(phr.)：如果你嘗試你就會進步。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：你考慮過這個建議了嗎？
boss.ans: HAVE YOU CONSIDERED THIS SUGGESTION YET
boss.speak: have you considered this suggestion yet
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAVE YOU CONSIDERED THIS SUGGESTION YET」(phr.)：你考慮過這個建議了嗎？。

boss.desc: 請唸出：價格最近已經上漲了。
boss.speak: prices have increased recently
boss.explain: 口說表達「PRICES HAVE INCREASED RECENTLY」(phr.)：價格最近已經上漲了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：今年的銷售額已經減少了。
boss.speak: sales have decreased this year
boss.explain: 口說表達「SALES HAVE DECREASED THIS YEAR」(phr.)：今年的銷售額已經減少了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：我注意到了一些巨大的改變。
boss.ans: I HAVE NOTICED SOME BIG CHANGES
boss.speak: i have noticed some big changes
boss.explain: 口說表達「I HAVE NOTICED SOME BIG CHANGES」(phr.)：我注意到了一些巨大的改變。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：這棟建築物內禁止吸菸。
boss.ans: SMOKING IS FORBIDDEN IN THIS BUILDING
boss.speak: smoking is forbidden in this building
boss.explain: 口說表達「SMOKING IS FORBIDDEN IN THIS BUILDING」(phr.)：這棟建築物內禁止吸菸。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：許可已經被給出了。
boss.speak: permission has been given
boss.explain: 口說表達「PERMISSION HAS BEEN GIVEN」(phr.)：許可已經被給出了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果你抽菸將會被罰款。
boss.ans: IF YOU SMOKE YOU WILL BE FINED
boss.speak: if you smoke you will be fined
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF YOU SMOKE YOU WILL BE FINED」(phr.)：如果你抽菸將會被罰款。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：電梯已經被修好了。
boss.speak: the elevator has been fixed
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE ELEVATOR HAS BEEN FIXED」(phr.)：電梯已經被修好了。。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you backed up all your important files yet?
options: A. Yes, I saved them to the cloud yesterday.
B. The files have been deleted by mistake.
C. If you backup the files, they will be safe.
D. No, the computer is too expensive.
boss.explain:
Have you backed up all your important files yet? (你已經備份所有重要的檔案了嗎？)
A. 是的，我昨天把它們存到雲端了。
B. 檔案不小心被刪除了。
C. 如果你備份檔案，它們就會很安全。
D. 不，這台電腦太貴了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the landlord raises the rent, what will you do?
options: A. The rent has been paid in full.
B. I will probably look for a cheaper place.
C. The apartment has two bedrooms.
D. If he raises it, I will buy a new car.
boss.explain:
If the landlord raises the rent, what will you do? (如果房東漲房租，你會怎麼做？)
A. 租金已經全額付清了。
B. 我可能會找個便宜一點的地方。
C. 這間公寓有兩間臥室。
D. 如果他漲價，我會買一輛新車。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has your broken phone been fixed by the technician?
options: A. If you break it, you buy it.
B. The phone is ringing right now.
C. Not yet, they are still waiting for some parts.
D. The technician has bought a new phone.
boss.explain:
Has your broken phone been fixed by the technician? (你壞掉的手機已經被技師修好了嗎？)
A. 如果你弄壞了，你就要買下來。
B. 手機現在正在響。
C. 還沒，他們還在等一些零件。
D. 技師買了一支新手機。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If I join the online workshop, will I get a digital badge?
options: A. The workshop has been canceled.
B. Yes, it will be emailed to you after the session.
C. I have never joined any workshops before.
D. The badge has been printed twice.
boss.explain:
If I join the online workshop, will I get a digital badge? (如果我參加線上工作坊，我會拿到數位徽章嗎？)
A. 工作坊已經取消了。
B. 會的，課程結束後會用電子郵件寄給你。
C. 我以前從來沒有參加過任何工作坊。
D. 徽章已經印了兩次。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The air conditioner in the meeting room has finally been repaired.
options: A. That is great news, we were freezing yesterday.
B. If it is broken, we will repair it.
C. I have not checked the meeting room.
D. The air conditioner is very old.
boss.explain:
The air conditioner in the meeting room has finally been repaired. (會議室的冷氣終於修好了。)
A. 真是好消息，我們昨天快凍僵了。
B. 如果它壞了，我們會修理。
C. 我還沒檢查過會議室。
D. 冷氣非常舊。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: I have injured my knee while playing basketball.
options: A. You should see a doctor and get some rest.
B. The basketball has been lost.
C. If you play basketball, you will win.
D. My knee has been cured completely.
boss.explain:
I have injured my knee while playing basketball. (我打籃球時傷到了膝蓋。)
A. 你應該去看醫生並休息一下。
B. 籃球已經不見了。
C. 如果你打籃球，你就會贏。
D. 我的膝蓋已經完全治癒了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the physical therapy does not work, what is the next step?
options: A. The therapy has been very successful.
B. We will take a walk in the park.
C. The doctor might suggest an operation.
D. If it works, you will feel better.
boss.explain:
If the physical therapy does not work, what is the next step? (如果物理治療沒效，下一步是什麼？)
A. 治療非常成功。
B. 我們去公園散步吧。
C. 醫生可能會建議動手術。
D. 如果有效，你會感覺好點。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has the new co-worker finished the training program?
options: A. The program is on television.
B. Yes, she has passed all the tests.
C. If you train hard, you will succeed.
D. The co-worker has not arrived yet.
boss.explain:
Has the new co-worker finished the training program? (新同事完成訓練計畫了嗎？)
A. 節目正在電視上播。
B. 是的，她通過了所有測試。
C. 如果你努力訓練，你就會成功。
D. 同事還沒到。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If we hire professional movers, will they pack the boxes too?
options: A. Yes, but they will charge an extra fee.
B. The boxes have been unpacked.
C. If you pack them, they will be heavy.
D. I have moved to a new city.
boss.explain:
If we hire professional movers, will they pack the boxes too? (如果我們雇請專業搬家工人，他們也會打包箱子嗎？)
A. 會的，但他們會收取額外費用。
B. 箱子已經拆開了。
C. 如果你打包它們，它們會很重。
D. 我已經搬到一個新城市了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The early bird tickets for the seminar have been sold out.
options: A. The seminar was very boring.
B. If you wake up early, you will see birds.
C. That is a pity, I will have to pay the regular price.
D. The tickets have been found in the bag.
boss.explain:
The early bird tickets for the seminar have been sold out. (研討會的早鳥票已經賣完了。)
A. 研討會非常無聊。
B. 如果你早起，你會看到鳥。
C. 真可惜，我只好付原價了。
D. 票在包包裡找到了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Have you discussed the new rules with your team?
options: A. The rules have been broken.
B. Yes, we had a long meeting about it this morning.
C. If you play by the rules, it is fair.
D. My team is very large.
boss.explain:
Have you discussed the new rules with your team? (你跟你的團隊討論過新規定了嗎？)
A. 規定已經被打破了。
B. 是的，我們今天早上為此開了個很長的會。
C. 如果你遵守規則，這很公平。
D. 我的團隊非常大。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the screen is cracked, can it still be used?
options: A. The screen has been cracked for a month.
B. Yes, but it might hurt your fingers.
C. If it is used, it will be broken.
D. The crack is very small.
boss.explain:
If the screen is cracked, can it still be used? (如果螢幕裂了，還能用嗎？)
A. 螢幕已經裂了一個月了。
B. 可以，但可能會刮傷你的手指。
C. 如果被使用，它就會壞掉。
D. 裂痕非常小。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: The neighborhood has been perfectly quiet since we moved in.
options: A. I am glad you found such a peaceful place.
B. If it is noisy, we will move out.
C. The neighborhood is very crowded.
D. We have moved in perfectly.
boss.explain:
The neighborhood has been perfectly quiet since we moved in. (自從我們搬進來後，這個社區一直非常安靜。)
A. 很高興你找到這麼平靜的地方。
B. 如果很吵，我們就會搬走。
C. 社區非常擁擠。
D. 我們搬進來得非常完美。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Has your swollen ankle been examined by a specialist?
options: A. Yes, he said nothing is broken.
B. The ankle has been swollen for a week.
C. If you examine it, you will know.
D. The specialist is very busy today.
boss.explain:
Has your swollen ankle been examined by a specialist? (你腫脹的腳踝給專科醫生檢查過了嗎？)
A. 是的，他說沒有骨折。
B. 腳踝已經腫了一個禮拜了。
C. 如果你檢查它，你就會知道。
D. 專科醫生今天非常忙。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the wifi signal is lost, what should we do?
options: A. The wifi has been connected.
B. Try restarting the router in the hallway.
C. If you lose it, you will not find it.
D. The signal is very strong.
boss.explain:
If the wifi signal is lost, what should we do? (如果 wifi 訊號斷了，我們該怎麼辦？)
A. wifi 已經連上了。
B. 試試看重新啟動走廊上的路由器。
C. 如果你弄丟了，就找不到了。
D. 訊號非常強。

boss.desc: 【短文】請選出正確使用 ATMOSPHERE 與 SURVIVE 的句子：
options: A. The planet is too cold.
B. The air is not safe for humans.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出大氣主要由二氧化碳組成，人類呼吸它將無法生存（will not survive），因此空氣對人類不安全。選項 B 正確。

boss.desc: 【時態與被動】「被發現」請選出適當的英文單字填入：
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 species 這裡搭配 fifty 視為複數，且句尾有 this year alone（光是今年），通常與現在完成式連用，新物種是「被發現」，故選 A (have been)。

boss.desc: 【短文】閱讀「the sun is blocked by the moon」後，選出符合文意的選項：
options: A. The sun blocks the earth.
B. The moon blocks the sun.
C. The earth blocks the moon.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中開頭直接說明「the sun is blocked by the moon」（太陽被月亮遮住），這就是日食的原因。選項 B 符合文意。

boss.desc: 【短文】閱讀「keeps us on the ground」後，選出符合文意的選項：
options: C. It pulls objects down to the ground.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到重力會將物體拉向彼此，且「keeps us on the ground」（讓我們留在地面）。選項 C「將物體拉向地面」最符合描述。

boss.desc: 【時態與被動】請選出正確符合句型「MYSTERY」的選項：
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 The mystery 為單數，句末有 yet，因此需使用現在完成被動式（has not been + p.p.）。選項 D 正確。

boss.desc: 【短文】請選出正確符合句型「CONFUSE」的選項：
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中表示如果不清楚標示退貨政策，顧客可能會困惑（might get confused），因此法律規定需提供明確指示，目的在於避免顧客困惑，選 B。

boss.desc: 【時態與被動】「已經被修改」請選出適當的英文單字填入：
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：句子結構為 have been + 過去分詞，表示「已經被修改」。選項 B modified 是 modify 的過去分詞，符合文法要求。

boss.desc: 填空題：B _ N _ F _ T (益處)
boss.speak: benefit
boss.explain: BENEFIT (n.)：益處。填空答案為「EEI」。

boss.desc: 填空題：F _ R N _ T _ R E (家具)
boss.speak: furniture
boss.explain: FURNITURE (n.)：家具。填空答案為「UIU」。例句：We bought modern wooden furniture for our new living room yesterday.（我們昨天為新客廳買了現代風的木製家具。）

boss.desc: 填空題：S U _ T _ B L _ (適合的)
boss.speak: suitable
boss.explain: SUITABLE (adj.)：適合的。填空答案為「IAE」。例句：I have finally found a suitable instructor for the class.（我終於為這堂課找到一位適合的講師了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：M _ T E R _ A _ (材料)
boss.speak: material
boss.explain: MATERIAL (n.)：材料。填空答案為「AIL」。例句：All materials have been prepared for the workshop.（工作坊的所有材料都已經準備好了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ M M _ N I T _ (社區)
boss.speak: community
boss.explain: COMMUNITY (n.)：社區。填空答案為「OUY」。例句：He has lived in this community for ten years.（他已經在這個社區住了十年了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：信心
boss.speak: confidence
boss.explain: CONFIDENCE (n.)：信心。例句：She has gained more confidence in speaking English.（她在說英文這方面獲得了更多信心。）

boss.desc: 填空題：C _ N F _ D E N _ E (信心)
boss.speak: confidence
boss.explain: CONFIDENCE (n.)：信心。填空答案為「OIC」。例句：She has gained more confidence in speaking English.（她在說英文這方面獲得了更多信心。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：聚會
boss.speak: gathering
boss.explain: GATHERING (n.)：聚會。例句：We have organized a small gathering for the new neighbors.（我們已經為新鄰居舉辦了一場小型聚會。）

boss.desc: 填空題：G _ T H _ R I N _ (聚會)
boss.speak: gathering
boss.explain: GATHERING (n.)：聚會。填空答案為「AEG」。例句：We have organized a small gathering for the new neighbors.（我們已經為新鄰居舉辦了一場小型聚會。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：講師
boss.speak: instructor
boss.explain: INSTRUCTOR (n.)：講師；教練。例句：Our new instructor has taught here for five years.（我們的新講師已經在這裡教五年了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：I N S T R _ C T _ R (講師)
boss.speak: instructor
boss.explain: INSTRUCTOR (n.)：講師。填空答案為「UO」。例句：Our new instructor has taught here for five years.（我們的新講師已經在這裡教五年了。）

boss.desc: 請拼出：不幸地
boss.speak: unfortunately
boss.explain: UNFORTUNATELY (adv.)：不幸地；遺憾地。例句：Unfortunately, the event has been canceled.（遺憾地，活動已經被取消了。）

boss.desc: 填空題：U N F _ R T U N _ T E L _ (不幸地)
boss.speak: unfortunately
boss.explain: UNFORTUNATELY (adv.)：不幸地。填空答案為「OAY」。例句：Unfortunately, the event has been canceled.（遺憾地，活動已經被取消了。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：過敏的
boss.speak: allergic
boss.explain: 口說表達「ALLERGIC」(adj.)：過敏的。例句：He is highly allergic to peanuts.（他對花生嚴重過敏。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：但願
boss.speak: hopefully
boss.explain: 口說表達「HOPEFULLY」(adv.)：但願。例句：Hopefully, the weather will be nice.（但願天氣會很好。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：份量
boss.speak: portion
boss.explain: 口說表達「PORTION」(n.)：份量。例句：The portion was surprisingly large.（份量大得令人驚訝。）

boss.desc: 請唸出單字：承諾
boss.speak: promise
boss.explain: 口說表達「PROMISE」(v.)：承諾。例句：She promised to help me with the homework.（她答應要幫我寫作業。）

boss.desc: 請唸出：嚴重過敏
boss.speak: highly allergic
boss.explain: 口說表達「HIGHLY ALLERGIC」(phr.)：嚴重過敏。

boss.desc: 請唸出：看起來很忙碌
boss.speak: looks quite busy
boss.explain: 口說表達「LOOKS QUITE BUSY」(phr.)：看起來很忙碌。

boss.desc: 請唸出：希望能見到你
boss.speak: hope to see you
boss.explain: 口說表達「HOPE TO SEE YOU」(phr.)：希望能見到你。

boss.desc: 請唸出：樂意接受
boss.speak: gladly accept
boss.explain: 口說表達「GLADLY ACCEPT」(phr.)：樂意接受。

boss.desc: 請唸出：語音信箱已經被查看過了嗎？
boss.ans: HAS THE VOICEMAIL BEEN CHECKED YET
boss.speak: has the voicemail been checked yet
boss.explain: 口說表達「HAS THE VOICEMAIL BEEN CHECKED YET」(phr.)：語音信箱已經被查看過了嗎？。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果湯很辣我就不喝了。
boss.ans: IF THE SOUP IS SPICY I CANNOT EAT IT
boss.speak: if the soup is spicy i cannot eat it
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF THE SOUP IS SPICY I CANNOT EAT IT」(phr.)：如果湯很辣我就不喝了。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：如果你出席，我們會很高興。
boss.ans: IF YOU ATTEND WE WILL BE HAPPY
boss.speak: if you attend we will be happy
boss.explain: 口說表達「IF YOU ATTEND WE WILL BE HAPPY」(phr.)：如果你出席，我們會很高興。。

boss.desc: 請唸出：退款還沒有被給予。
boss.ans: THE REFUND HAS NOT BEEN GIVEN YET
boss.speak: the refund has not been given yet
boss.explain: 口說表達「THE REFUND HAS NOT BEEN GIVEN YET」(phr.)：退款還沒有被給予。。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the earphone is broken, where should I go?
options: A. Please return to the service desk for a new one.
B. I usually listen to classical music on my phone.
C. The volume is already turned up to the maximum.
D. We will finish the guided tour in ten minutes.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the earphone is broken, where should I go? 意思：如果耳機壞了，我該去哪裡？選項 A「請回到服務台換一個新的」最符合邏輯。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the guide speaks too quietly, what should we do?
options: A. We can read the information in the guidebook instead.
B. The museum guide is very professional and friendly.
C. We should keep quiet while looking at the paintings.
D. The exhibition hall is going to close very soon.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the guide speaks too quietly, what should we do? 意思：如果導覽員說話太小聲，我們該怎麼辦？選項 A「我們可以改看導覽手冊裡的資訊」是合理的解決辦法。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the street is flooded, how will we get home?
options: A. The street is very crowded on weekends.
B. We might have to take the underground subway.
C. I forgot my umbrella at the office today.
D. The flood has caused a lot of damage here.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the street is flooded, how will we get home? 意思：如果街道淹水了，我們要怎麼回家？選項 B「我們可能得搭乘地下捷運」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: A serious warning has been issued by the weather center.
options: A. 氣象中心表示明天的天氣會非常晴朗。
B. 氣象中心已經發布了一項嚴重的警告。
C. 天氣警告已經被氣象中心悄悄撤回了。
D. 氣象中心警告大家不要前往山區活動。
boss.explain: 英文原句：A serious warning has been issued by the weather center. 意思：氣象中心已經發布了一項嚴重的警告。（serious 嚴重的；has been issued 已經被發布）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the bridge is closed, which way should we drive?
options: A. The bridge was built fifty years ago.
B. We must cross the bridge carefully.
C. The driver is very experienced.
D. We can take the mountain road instead.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the bridge is closed, which way should we drive? 意思：如果橋關閉了，我們該開哪條路？選項 D「我們可以改走山路」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If I fail the final exam, can I take it again?
options: A. Yes, the exam was extremely difficult.
B. No, you passed the final exam with high marks.
C. Yes, the final exam takes two hours to finish.
D. No, you will have to retake the whole course next year.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If I fail the final exam, can I take it again? 意思：如果我期末考不及格，我可以重考嗎？選項 D「不行，你明年必須重修整門課」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The student ID card has been handed to you.
options: A. 你的學生證已經遺失在辦公室了。
B. 學校要求你明天繳回學生證。
C. 你的學生證已經被系統註銷。
D. 學生證已經交到你的手上了。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The student ID card has been handed to you. 意思：學生證已經交到你的手上了。（has been handed 已經被交出）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the cafeteria is full, where can we eat?
options: A. The cafeteria serves delicious pasta on Fridays.
B. Let's buy some sandwiches and sit in the park.
C. I am not very hungry right now, to be honest.
D. The lunch break ends at one o'clock exactly.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the cafeteria is full, where can we eat? 意思：如果自助餐廳客滿了，我們能在哪裡吃？選項 B「我們去買些三明治坐在公園吃吧」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If I cannot eat seafood, will they offer other dishes?
options: A. Seafood is the most popular dish tonight.
B. Yes, you can choose the chicken or vegetarian meal.
C. I also like eating fresh fish by the ocean.
D. No, the kitchen is fully closed on Sundays.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If I cannot eat seafood, will they offer other dishes? 意思：如果我不能吃海鮮，他們會提供其他菜餚嗎？選項 B「會，你可以選擇雞肉或素食餐」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The special rewards have been presented to the top salespeople.
options: A. 最佳銷售員們即將上台領取特別獎勵。
B. 特別獎勵已經頒發給了最佳銷售員。
C. 只有最佳銷售員才有資格申請特別獎勵。
D. 公司取消了發給最佳銷售員的特別獎勵。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The special rewards have been presented to the top salespeople. 意思：特別獎勵已經頒發給了最佳銷售員。（has been presented 已經被頒發/呈現）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If we drink alcohol, who will drive the car?
options: A. The wine tastes perfectly sweet and fresh.
B. Driving a car in the city is extremely hard.
C. We can buy some alcohol at the supermarket.
D. I will call a driver to take us back to the hotel.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If we drink alcohol, who will drive the car? 意思：如果我們喝酒了，誰來開車？選項 D「我會叫司機載我們回飯店」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If I want to cancel my plan, will I get a refund?
options: A. The gym has a lot of new running machines.
B. Yes, you can change your plan at any time.
C. I plan to visit my grandparents this weekend.
D. No, you will only get your money back within seven days.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If I want to cancel my plan, will I get a refund? 意思：如果我想取消方案，可以獲得退款嗎？選項 D「不行，你只能在七天內退費」最符合情境。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The locker rooms have been locked for cleaning.
options: A. 置物櫃的鎖已經全部更換為密碼鎖。
B. 因為發現失竊，更衣室的門被鎖上了。
C. 為了讓會員休息，更衣室目前對外開放。
D. 更衣室因為要進行清潔而鎖起來了。
boss.explain: 英文原句：The locker rooms have been locked for cleaning. 意思：更衣室因為要進行清潔而鎖起來了。（has been locked 已經被鎖上）

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the yoga class is full, can I join the next one?
options: A. The yoga teacher is very famous around here.
B. Yes, I will put your name on the waiting list.
C. No, the classroom is not big enough for everyone.
D. Yoga is great for relaxing your body and mind.
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the yoga class is full, can I join the next one? 意思：如果瑜伽課滿了，我可以參加下一堂嗎？選項 B「可以，我會把你的名字放進候補名單」最合理。

boss.desc: 【條件句與被動語態】If the online payment ___, the system will automatically generate an electronic receipt for you.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：這是稍微進階的融合題。If 條件句中須用現在簡單式，且主詞 online payment（線上付款）是被確認的對象，故須使用現在式被動語態 (is confirmed)。

boss.desc: 【時態與被動】Over the past few months, the old library ___ into a modern community center.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：時間副詞 Over the past few months 需搭配現在完成式；而圖書館是「被改造」的，因此要用現在完成式的被動語態 (has been + p.p.)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】If they ___ the issue immediately, the problem will only get worse.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：第一類條件句中，主要子句用未來式 (will get)，If 子句需用現在式。主詞 they 為主動解決問題，故選現在簡單主動的否定 (do not resolve)。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】Since the new manager arrived, communication between the teams ___ significantly.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：Since 子句用過去式，主要子句須搭配現在完成式 (has/have + p.p.)，表示從過去持續到現在的進步。improve 在此作不及物動詞，主動即可。

boss.desc:
【短文】Event Update: The outdoor festival has been canceled due to heavy storms. If you purchased your ticket online, a full refund will be processed within five days. 
Question: What will happen to online ticket buyers?
options: A. They will receive new tickets
B. They must attend next week
C. They will get their money back
D. They have to call the organizer
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到如果線上購票，全額退款 (refund) 將在五天內處理。這表示他們會拿回買票的錢 (get their money back)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Library Rules: Books can be borrowed for two weeks. If a book is not returned on time, the member is charged a small fee. This rule has been strictly applied since last year. 
Question: What happens if a book is returned late?
options: A. The book is thrown away
B. The member cannot borrow books again
D. The member must pay a fee
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出如果不按時歸還 (not returned on time)，會員將被收取一筆小費用 (charged a small fee)。因此選 D。

boss.desc: 【綜合句型】If you are traveling abroad, your passport must ___ before you book the flight.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：護照是「被檢查」的對象，助動詞 must 後面接原形，因此被動語態為 must + be + p.p. (be checked)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Health Warning: Staring at screens for hours causes eye strain. If you look at a distant object every twenty minutes, your eyes will relax. This method is highly recommended by doctors. 
Question: How can one reduce eye strain?
options: A. By staring closely at the screen
B. By looking at something far away
C. By closing the eyes for an hour
D. By visiting a doctor every day
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中建議每二十分鐘看一次遠處的物體 (look at a distant object)，這能讓眼睛放鬆。distant object 即為 something far away。

boss.desc: 【時態】The company ___ its target for this quarter, so everyone will receive a bonus.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：公司「已經達到」本季的目標，結果是大家會拿到獎金。強調動作完成並對現在/未來產生影響，使用現在完成式 (has reached) 最為合理。

boss.desc:
【對話】A: Have you reviewed the document? 
B: Yes, but I found some errors. If they are not corrected, the document ___ tonight.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用現在式的被動語態 (are not corrected)，主要子句表示未來的結果，須用未來式的被動語態，文件「將不會被寄出」(will not be sent)。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The software will automatically ___ your personal data to prevent others from seeing it.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：為了防止他人看見，軟體會自動「保護 (protect)」你的個人資料。其他選項：建議 (suggest)、展示 (display)、辨識 (recognize) 均不符合防護資料的情境。

boss.desc: 【被動語態】The latest fashion trends ___ by social media more than ever before.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞 trends（趨勢）是複數，且是「被影響」的對象，所以要用現在式複數的被動語態 (are influenced)。

boss.desc:
【短文】Online Learning Platform: Welcome to the advanced coding course. The first video has been uploaded to your student account. If you pass the final test, a digital badge will be awarded to you. 
Question: How can a student get a digital badge?
options: C. By passing the final test
boss.explain: 文中說明「If you pass the final test, a digital badge will be awarded to you.（如果你通過最終測驗，將會獲頒數位徽章）」，故選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Message from Tutor: I have checked your recent assignments. Your writing has gotten much better lately. However, if you want a higher grade, you must check your spelling more carefully. 
Question: What does the tutor advise the student to do?
boss.explain: 導師在訊息中提到「if you want a higher grade, you must check your spelling more carefully（如果想要更高的分數，必須更仔細檢查拼字）」，因此選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Sports News: The national swimming championship was held last weekend. Several local records were broken by the young athletes. If they keep practicing hard, they will join the Olympic team next year. 
Question: What happened at the swimming championship?
options: A. New local records were set
B. The Olympic team was defeated
C. The swimming pool was closed
boss.explain: 新聞中提到「Several local records were broken by the young athletes（年輕運動員打破了幾項當地紀錄）」，這表示建立了新紀錄，因此選 A。

boss.desc:
【短文】Stadium Rule: All glass bottles are prohibited inside the arena. If you bring one, it will be taken away at the gate. Drinks can only be bought from the official stores inside. 
Question: Why will a glass bottle be taken away?
options: A. Because it is too heavy
B. Because it is not allowed inside
C. Because it is sold out
D. Because it belongs to the stadium
boss.explain: 規定中說「All glass bottles are prohibited（所有玻璃瓶皆被禁止）」，這就是為什麼會被沒收（taken away）的原因。

boss.desc:
【短文】Local News: A new public park has been opened in the city center. It features a large playground and a beautiful lake. If citizens keep the park clean, the city will build more parks like this. 
Question: What is the condition for building more parks?
options: A. The mayor must visit daily
B. The playground must be closed
C. Citizens must keep the park clean
D. The lake must be filled with fish
boss.explain: 短文中指出「If citizens keep the park clean, the city will build more parks like this.（如果市民保持公園清潔，城市將會建造更多這樣的公園）」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Tech Update: The popular social media app has crashed globally. Millions of users have been affected since this morning. Engineers say that if the main server is restarted, the app will work again. 
Question: How will the app be fixed?
options: B. By buying a new phone
D. By restarting the main server
boss.explain: 工程師表示「if the main server is restarted, the app will work again（如果重啟主伺服器，應用程式將恢復運作）」，故選 D。

boss.desc:
【短文】Internal Email: We have updated the office security system. A new access code has been sent to your phone. If you enter the wrong code three times, the door will be locked completely. 
Question: What happens after three wrong attempts?
options: C. A new code is sent
boss.explain: 信件中寫道「If you enter the wrong code three times, the door will be locked completely.（如果輸入錯誤密碼三次，門將會完全鎖死）」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Office Memo: The annual staff party will be planned by the marketing team this year. It will be held at a seaside restaurant. If you plan to go to the party, please answer this email before Wednesday. 
Question: Who is planning the staff party?
boss.explain: 備忘錄第一句為「The annual staff party will be planned by the marketing team this year.（今年的年度員工派對將由行銷團隊策劃）」，因此選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Property Update: The rent for this apartment includes internet and water. Electricity is paid by the renter. If you sign a two-year lease today, the first month will be free. 
Question: Which bill is NOT included in the rent?
boss.explain: 短文中提到「Electricity is paid by the renter.（電費由租客支付）」，代表電費沒有包含在租金中。

boss.desc:
【短文】Language School: Our Spanish classes are designed for busy adults. Lessons are recorded and can be watched anytime. If you have questions, they will be answered by our teachers during the weekend live sessions. 
Question: When can students ask teachers questions directly?
options: D. During the weekend live sessions
boss.explain: 文中說明「If you have questions, they will be answered by our teachers during the weekend live sessions.（如果有問題，老師會在週末直播時段回答）」。

boss.desc:
【短文】Running Club: Welcome to the city marathon! The race path has been marked with yellow signs. If you feel sick during the run, medical tents can be found every five kilometers. 
Question: How is the race path marked?
boss.explain: 文中的第二句是「The race path has been marked with yellow signs.（比賽路線已經用黃色標誌標示）」，故選 B。

boss.desc:
【短文】Weather Alert: Heavy snow has been predicted for the northern region. Major highways might be closed by the police tonight. If you must travel, drive slowly and carry warm clothes. 
Question: What might the police do tonight?
boss.explain: 警報中提到「Major highways might be closed by the police tonight.（今晚主要高速公路可能被警方封閉）」，因此選 C。

boss.desc:
【短文】Manager's Note: The new printer has been placed in the hallway. It is faster and uses less ink. If the paper jams, do not pull it; call IT support instead. 
Question: What should staff do if the printer paper jams?
boss.explain: 主管的紙條中明確指示「If the paper jams, do not pull it; call IT support instead.（如果卡紙，不要硬拉；改為打給 IT 支援）」。
